keys: Save the sheet - compile-on-save keeps its generated script fresh (Ctrl+S).
zh_CN: 保存事件表 - 保存时编译会让其生成的脚本保持最新（Ctrl+S）。

keys: Save, then play the scene that uses this sheet's script.
zh_CN: 保存后，运行使用此事件表脚本的场景。

keys: Add a condition to the selected event (C).
zh_CN: 为所选事件添加一个条件（C）。

keys: Add an action to the selected event (A).
zh_CN: 为所选事件添加一个动作（A）。

keys: Toggle the generated-GDScript panel - the sheet's honest compiled output, side by side.
zh_CN: 切换生成的 GDScript 面板 - 事件表真实的编译输出，并排显示。

keys: Theme for this sheet (Load/Reload and the Theme Editor live in View)
zh_CN: 此事件表的主题（加载/重新加载和主题编辑器在“视图”菜单中）

keys: Create, open, save, and configure this event sheet.
zh_CN: 创建、打开、保存和配置此事件表。

keys: Panels, multi-view panes, theme, live values, and zoom.
zh_CN: 面板、多视图窗格、主题、实时值和缩放。

keys: Debug tools, validation, import, and project workflow.
zh_CN: 调试工具、验证、导入和项目工作流。

keys: Teach a Verb - Share Published Verbs
zh_CN: 传授动词 - 分享已发布的动词
在所选事件上添加代码（GDScript）
将所选内容提取到包含表…

keys: Show/hide the generated-GDScript panel beside the sheet.
zh_CN: 显示/隐藏事件表旁边生成的 GDScript 面板。

keys: Show/hide the trailing "+ Add event…" rows. Turn off for a cleaner, calmer sheet.
zh_CN: 显示/隐藏末尾的“+ 添加事件…”行。关闭后事件表更简洁清爽。

keys: Show/hide a second synchronized view of this sheet, side by side.
zh_CN: 显示/隐藏此事件表的第二个同步视图，并排显示。

keys: Pop the sheet view out into its own window / bring it back.
zh_CN: 将事件表视图弹出为独立窗口 / 收回。

keys: Link/unlink scrolling between the split views.
zh_CN: 联动/取消联动拆分视图之间的滚动。

keys: Toggle breakpoint emission: debug-compiled sheets pause at rows with breakpoints.
zh_CN: 切换断点输出：以调试模式编译的事件表会在带断点的行暂停。

keys: Toggle Live Values: running sheets stream their variables here (editable).
zh_CN: 切换实时值：运行中的事件表会将其变量实时显示在此处（可编辑）。

keys: Double-click anywhere - or press E - to add your first event.
zh_CN: 双击任意位置 - 或按 E - 添加你的第一个事件。

keys: Double-click anywhere - or press E - to add an event that drives the Node this attaches to.
zh_CN: 双击任意位置 - 或按 E - 添加一个事件来驱动此表所附加的 Node。

keys: Create one to start building - a menu of ready-made starters opens.
zh_CN: 创建一个即可开始 - 会打开一个现成起步模板菜单。

keys: Add the signals and functions every sheet in the project should reach (score, game state, an event bus).
zh_CN: 添加项目中每个事件表都应能访问的信号和函数（分数、游戏状态、事件总线）。

keys: Tip: the picker understands plain language. Try typing "every tick".
zh_CN: 提示：选择器能理解日常语言。试试输入 “every tick”。

keys: Tip: Tools > Welcome… has a playable showcase and a 2-minute tour.
zh_CN: 提示：工具 > 欢迎… 中有可玩的演示和 2 分钟导览。

keys: Tip: publish a function to the picker and every sheet in the project can call it.
zh_CN: 提示：将函数发布到选择器后，项目中的每个事件表都能调用它。

zh_CN: %s - 编辑器工具 · 在编辑器中运行（文件 > 运行）

keys: %s - Custom Resource · every .tres of it is a data asset
zh_CN: %s - 自定义资源 · 它的每个 .tres 都是一份数据资产

keys: Event Sheet · a script for the %s it's attached to
zh_CN: 事件表 · 附加到 %s 上的脚本

keys: Click to edit the sheet type (name, icon, host class).
zh_CN: 点击编辑事件表类型（名称、图标、宿主类）。

keys: Pin the highlighted entry to Favorites (or right-click any entry).
zh_CN: 将高亮条目固定到收藏（或右键点击任意条目）。

keys: Right-click any entry to pin it here.
zh_CN: 右键点击任意条目即可固定到这里。
你用过的条目会显示在这里。

keys: Select a condition, action, or trigger to create a new event.
zh_CN: 选择一个条件、动作或触发器来创建新事件。

keys: Select an action to append to the selected event.
zh_CN: 选择一个动作追加到所选事件。

keys: Select a condition or trigger to append to the selected event.
zh_CN: 选择一个条件或触发器追加到所选事件。

keys: Filter the open sheets by name or path.
zh_CN: 按名称或路径筛选已打开的事件表。

zh_CN: 可在 Inspector 中编辑（设计师属性）

keys: Set on _ready() - for node refs like $Player
zh_CN: 在 _ready() 中设置 - 用于 $Player 之类的节点引用
文本 - 单词、名称、消息。

keys: A number - a count, score, position, speed… Tick "Whole numbers only" for integers.
zh_CN: 数字 - 计数、分数、位置、速度… 勾选“仅限整数”可存整数。

keys: An x/y pair: a direction, velocity, or position.
zh_CN: 一对 x/y 值：方向、速度或位置。

keys: Edit the .gd directly in Godot's script editor - your changes reload here when you come back to this tab.
zh_CN: 直接在 Godot 的脚本编辑器中编辑 .gd 文件 - 回到此标签页时，你的修改会在这里重新加载。

keys: Simple mode - hide advanced rows & menu items
zh_CN: 简易模式 - 隐藏高级行和菜单项

keys: Open the GDScript panel with every sheet
zh_CN: 每次打开事件表时同时打开 GDScript 面板
从其他事件表工具转来？

keys: Reopen this window any time: Tools → Welcome…
zh_CN: 随时可重新打开此窗口：工具 → 欢迎…

keys: Translations are plain CSV files - drop one into eventsheet_translations/ and its language appears here.
zh_CN: 翻译只是普通的 CSV 文件 - 放一个到 eventsheet_translations/ 中，它的语言就会出现在这里。

keys: Read a sheet like a sentence
zh_CN: 像读句子一样读事件表
✓ 完成 - 很棒！点击“下一步”。

keys: Hit Finish and go make something.
zh_CN: 点击“完成”，去创造点什么吧。

keys:
A coloured section label drawn above this property in the Inspector.
End with a #rrggbb to tint it. Editor decor only - plain comment in the code.
zh_CN:
在 Inspector 中此属性上方绘制的彩色分区标签。
结尾加 #rrggbb 可为其着色。仅为编辑器装饰 - 在代码中只是普通注释。

keys:
A quiet info panel drawn above this property in the Inspector.
Editor decor only - plain comment in the code.
zh_CN:
在 Inspector 中此属性上方绘制的低调信息面板。
仅为编辑器装饰 - 在代码中只是普通注释。
一条 0-1 区间的曲线（缓动、衰减、渐变）。

keys: A whole number (no decimals) - stored as an int. Unticked stores a float.
zh_CN: 整数（无小数）- 存储为 int。不勾选则存储为 float。

keys: Any type - untyped (advanced; prefer a specific type when you can).
zh_CN: 任意类型 - 无类型（高级；可能时请优先使用具体类型）。

keys: Collapse the panel to a strip

zh_CN: 缓动曲线（float：指数缓动手柄）

keys: Edit an Array/Dictionary's items one per line instead of typing a literal.
zh_CN: 逐行编辑 Array/Dictionary 的元素，而不是手动输入字面量。

keys: Event-sheet-style quick add: type an event/condition/action (event-sheet phrasing works) plus optional parameter values, press Enter.
zh_CN: 事件表风格的快速添加：输入事件/条件/动作（支持事件表式表述），可附带参数值，然后按 Enter。

keys: Every sheet function at a glance (✦ = published as an ACE). Click to expand or collapse.
zh_CN: 一览事件表中的所有函数（✦ = 已发布为 ACE）。点击可展开或折叠。

keys: How this variable's field LOOKS in the Inspector - pickers, flags, layer grids... Plain fields need no choice here.
zh_CN: 此变量的字段在 Inspector 中的外观 - 选择器、标志位、层网格… 普通字段无需在此选择。

keys: Inspector grouping, conditional show/lock, an on-changed callback, clamp, read-only - for variables that reference other variables or functions.
zh_CN: Inspector 分组、条件显示/锁定、on-changed 回调、范围限制、只读 - 适用于引用其他变量或函数的变量。
Inspector 分区标题（例如 Combat）

keys: Make this sheet's published verbs (its exposed ƒ functions) available in EVERY sheet's picker, node-targeted at $<ClassName>. Extract actions to a function first (right-click an event), then teach it here.
zh_CN: 让此事件表已发布的动词（其公开的 ƒ 函数）出现在所有事件表的选择器中，以 $<ClassName> 为目标节点。请先将动作提取为函数（右键点击事件），再在这里传授它。

keys: No alpha (Color: solid RGB, no transparency)

On: a designer can tweak this per-instance in the Inspector (@export var).
Off: internal script state - a plain private var (the default for a new variable).
zh_CN:
开启：设计师可在 Inspector 中按实例调整（@export var）。
关闭：脚本内部状态 - 普通私有变量（新变量的默认设置）。

keys:
On: compiles to @onready var - the Default is a GDScript EXPRESSION evaluated when the node enters the tree (e.g. $Player, get_node("UI/Score")), not a literal.
Use it to grab a node reference once the scene is ready.
zh_CN:
开启：编译为 @onready var - 默认值是节点进入场景树时求值的 GDScript 表达式（例如 $Player、get_node("UI/Score")），而不是字面量。
用它在场景就绪后获取节点引用。

keys:
One column per entry: name:type (String, int, float, bool, color for a swatch, or enum(a|b|c) for a dropdown).
Each Array element becomes a row with these cells.
zh_CN:
每个条目一列：名称:类型（String、int、float、bool，color 显示色块，enum(a|b|c) 显示下拉框）。
Array 的每个元素都会成为带这些单元格的一行。

keys: Optional Inspector polish for exported globals - everything compiles to plain Godot annotations.
zh_CN: 为导出的全局变量提供可选的 Inspector 修饰 - 一切都会编译为普通的 Godot 注解。

keys: Pick the Inspector look from picture tiles instead of the list.
zh_CN: 通过图片磁贴而非列表来选择 Inspector 外观。

keys:
Renders a small button with this field that calls the named sheet function.
Needs a @tool sheet to act in-editor. Label optional (defaults to the function name).
zh_CN:
在此字段旁渲染一个小按钮，用于调用指定的事件表函数。
需要 @tool 事件表才能在编辑器中生效。标签可选（默认为函数名）。

keys: Required (warn in the Inspector while unset)
zh_CN: 必填（未设置时在 Inspector 中警告）

keys: Scaffold a ready-to-edit behaviour script in res://eventsheet_addons/ - its signals become triggers, methods become actions/conditions, and @export vars become properties, all auto-discovered as custom ACEs.
zh_CN: 在 res://eventsheet_addons/ 中生成一个可直接编辑的行为脚本 - 它的信号会成为触发器，方法会成为动作/条件，@export 变量会成为属性，全部自动发现为自定义 ACE。

keys: See the WHOLE sheet's Inspector as one live view - every exported variable with its decor, grouping, and widget, exactly as Godot will show it.
zh_CN: 以一个实时视图查看整个事件表的 Inspector - 每个导出变量及其装饰、分组和控件，与 Godot 的实际显示完全一致。

keys: Shown after the number in the Inspector (suffix:px).
zh_CN: 显示在 Inspector 中数字之后（suffix:px）。

keys:
Shows a red warning above the field until a value is assigned
(a Resource left empty, a String left blank). Editor-only.
zh_CN:
在字段上方显示红色警告，直到赋值为止
（如 Resource 留空、String 为空白）。仅编辑器内有效。

keys: Start editing this sheet here. From then on, Save (Ctrl+S) updates the file - or use Save As… to keep the original and save a copy.
zh_CN: 从这里开始编辑此事件表。之后，保存（Ctrl+S）会更新文件 - 或使用另存为… 保留原文件并保存副本。

keys:
Swap the Inspector field for a richer drawer (dial, swatches, curve…).
Graceful: a plain field without the editor plugin (parity preserved).
zh_CN:
将 Inspector 字段换成更丰富的控件（旋钮、色板、曲线…）。
优雅降级：没有编辑器插件时显示为普通字段（保持一致性）。

keys:
The Inspector calls this function while the property is edited and shows
the returned message above the field. Needs a @tool sheet to run in-editor.
zh_CN:
Inspector 会在编辑该属性时调用此函数，并将
返回的消息显示在字段上方。需要 @tool 事件表才能在编辑器中运行。

keys: The slider stops at max but typing a bigger number is allowed (or_greater).
zh_CN: 滑块在最大值处停止，但允许输入更大的数字（or_greater）。

keys: The variable's type. For a node reference, type the node's class (Sprite2D, Label, Area2D…) or leave Variant.
zh_CN: 变量的类型。若是节点引用，请输入节点的类名（Sprite2D、Label、Area2D…）或保留 Variant。

keys: Turn the MCP server (AI-assistant tools) on/off. When off, connected AI clients see no tools and can't read or change your sheets. Takes effect live - no reconnect needed.
zh_CN: 开启/关闭 MCP 服务器（AI 助手工具）。关闭时，已连接的 AI 客户端看不到任何工具，也无法读取或修改你的事件表。即时生效 - 无需重新连接。
允许输入低于最小值的数字（or_less）。

keys: Write this sheet's plain, standalone GDScript to a file you own. No plugin dependency - proof you can leave the addon anytime.
zh_CN: 将此事件表的纯净、独立 GDScript 写入你自己的文件。不依赖插件 - 证明你随时可以离开此插件。

zh_CN: 逗号分隔，例如 easy, normal, hard（仅限 String）

zh_CN: 函数与按钮标签，例如 reroll_stats Reroll

最小值、最大值、步长（数值：滑块）

zh_CN: 返回警告 String 的事件表函数（为空 = 有效）

zh_CN: 类型 - 例如 Node2D、Label、Sprite2D（或用 Variant 表示任意）

keys: what this variable is for - shown as its description in the Inspector
zh_CN: 此变量的用途 - 会作为其描述显示在 Inspector 中
▸  高级（分组、条件、范围限制…）
▸  更多选项（范围、控件、分组…）

zh_CN: 显示在函数上方的文档（## …）。允许使用 [b]bold[/b] 之类的 BBCode。

keys: The name of the setter's incoming-value parameter (defaults to `value`).
zh_CN: Setter 传入值参数的名称（默认为 `value`）。

zh_CN: setter 函数体，例如  health = clampi(value, 0, max_health)

keys: A faint tint over the actions (right) lane.
zh_CN: 动作（右侧）栏上的淡淡色调。

keys: A faint tint over the conditions (left) lane.
zh_CN: 条件（左侧）栏上的淡淡色调。
分组标题的交替背景（斑马纹）。

keys: Background of a group header row.
Background of the Conditions / Actions column header bar.

keys: Corner roundness of region marker bubbles.

keys: Corner roundness of the chip, in pixels.

keys: Corner roundness of the event block, in pixels (0 = square).
zh_CN: 事件块的圆角程度，单位为像素（0 = 方形）。

keys: Extra width reserved for the role badge on the chip, in pixels.
zh_CN: 为条目上的角色徽章预留的额外宽度，单位为像素。
条件/动作条目的填充色。

keys: Fill of the count badge on a group.
zh_CN: 分组上计数徽章的填充色。

keys: Fill of the role badge on the chip.
zh_CN: 条目上角色徽章的填充色。

keys: Fill of the trigger arrow badge (On Ready, On Signal...).
zh_CN: 触发器箭头徽章的填充色（On Ready、On Signal…）。

keys: Height of a single event row, in pixels - raise it for more breathing room.
zh_CN: 单个事件行的高度，单位为像素 - 调大可获得更多留白。

Icon/text colour on the trigger badge.

keys: Inner padding on the actions lane, in pixels.
zh_CN: 动作栏的内边距，单位为像素。

keys: Line thickness of region marker borders.

zh_CN: 在 ACE 文本中高亮显示的参数值（数字、字符串）。

zh_CN: 鼠标所在的单个条件/动作单元格上的色调。

keys: Width reserved for the trigger/condition badge column.
zh_CN: 为触发器/条件徽章列预留的宽度。
禁用 / 启用所选内容
将所选内容归入新分组
将所选内容保存为片段…

keys: A list of numbers (Array[float]) - weights, timings, chances.
zh_CN: 数字列表（Array[float]） - 权重、计时、几率。

keys: A list of text entries (Array[String]) - names, lines, tags.
zh_CN: 文本条目列表（Array[String]） - 名称、台词、标签。

keys: A list of whole numbers (Array[int]) - scores, ids, tile indexes.
zh_CN: 整数列表（Array[int]） - 分数、id、图块索引。

keys: A list that can hold anything (mixed types allowed).
zh_CN: 可以容纳任何内容的列表（允许混合类型）。

keys: Fixed width of the object-name column in the actions lane (0 = text flows after each name). Also set by dragging the name/text gap in a row.
zh_CN: 动作栏中对象名称列的固定宽度（0 = 文本紧跟在每个名称之后）。也可以通过拖动行内名称/文本之间的间隔来设置。

keys: Fixed width of the object-name column in the conditions lane (0 = text flows after each name). Also set by dragging the name/text gap in a row.
zh_CN: 条件栏中对象名称列的固定宽度（0 = 文本紧跟在每个名称之后）。也可以通过拖动行内名称/文本之间的间隔来设置。

keys: Height of a group header bar, in pixels - double an event row by default; lower it for the classic slim bar.
zh_CN: 分组标题栏的高度（像素） - 默认是事件行的两倍；想要经典的窄条样式可以调低。

keys: Make your own data asset in three questions: name one entry, list its columns, done - a Resource whose Inspector is a fill-in table, saved as .tres files designers edit.
zh_CN: 回答三个问题就能做出自己的数据资产：给一条条目命名、列出它的列，完成 - 一个 Inspector 变成填写表格的 Resource，保存为设计师可编辑的 .tres 文件。

keys: Named anything (by text key) - a flexible data bag.
zh_CN: 命名的任意值（按文本键） - 灵活的数据袋。

keys: Named numbers (by text key) - e.g. volumes["music"] = 0.8.
zh_CN: 命名的数字（按文本键） - 例如 volumes["music"] = 0.8。

keys: Named slots holding anything: look values up by a key.
zh_CN: 可存放任何内容的命名槽位：按键查找值。

keys: Named text (by text key) - e.g. lines["greeting"].
zh_CN: 命名的文本（按文本键） - 例如 lines["greeting"]。

keys: Named whole numbers (by text key) - e.g. costs["sword"] = 10.
zh_CN: 命名的整数（按文本键） - 例如 costs["sword"] = 10。

keys: Start an editor-side tool sheet: its events run INSIDE the editor (script editor > File > Run), never in the game - batch renames, scene checks, one-click chores.
zh_CN: 创建一个编辑器端工具事件表：它的事件在编辑器内部运行（脚本编辑器 > File > Run），绝不会在游戏中运行 - 适合批量重命名、场景检查、一键杂务。

keys: Switch the EventSheets editor language. Drop a translation CSV into addons/eventsheet/translations/ and it appears here automatically.
zh_CN: 切换 EventSheets 编辑器语言。把翻译 CSV 放入 addons/eventsheet/translations/，它就会自动出现在这里。

keys: Makes your own data asset: a Resource with a table designers fill in the Inspector and save as .tres files - loot tables, dialogue lines, wave plans, anything that is rows of data. No annotations to learn; describe the rows and the sheet is generated.
zh_CN: 生成你自己的数据资产：一个带表格的 Resource，设计师在 Inspector 中填写并保存为 .tres 文件 - 掉落表、对话台词、波次计划，任何按行组织的数据都行。无需学习任何注解；描述好行，事件表就会自动生成。

keys:
One column per line. Plain words make a text column; add ": float", ": int", or ": bool" for numbers and toggles; list choices with | for a dropdown.
name
kind: coin|gem|key
weight: float
zh_CN:
每行一列。普通词语会成为文本列；加上 ": float"、": int" 或 ": bool" 表示数字和开关；用 | 列出选项即可得到下拉框。
name
kind: coin|gem|key
weight: float

keys: Warn in the Inspector until the table has rows (required)
zh_CN: 在表格有行之前，在 Inspector 中给出警告（必填）

keys: Add a validation check (a function warning about bad data, live)
zh_CN: 添加验证检查（实时警告错误数据的函数）

keys: Creates a ready-to-edit validate function: it runs while the table is edited in the Inspector and shows any warning it returns above the field. Add your own rules as condition rows.
zh_CN: 创建一个可直接编辑的 validate 函数：在 Inspector 中编辑表格时它会运行，并把返回的警告显示在字段上方。用条件行添加你自己的规则。

keys: Show this function as a one-click button in the Inspector, labelled with this text. Pressing the button runs the function's rows - great for editor chores like re-baking, refilling, or validating.
zh_CN: 把这个函数显示为 Inspector 中的一键按钮，并用此文本作为标签。按下按钮会运行函数的行 - 非常适合重新烘焙、重新填充、验证等编辑器杂务。

keys: Plain GDScript - anything valid in an expression works here. Ctrl+Space completes sheet variables/functions and host members. Alt+Enter grows the box for a long expression (and shrinks it back).
zh_CN: 纯 GDScript - 表达式中有效的任何内容都可以在这里使用。Ctrl+Space 补全事件表变量/函数和宿主成员。Alt+Enter 会放大输入框以容纳长表达式（也能再缩回去）。

keys: Find Expressions - open the expressions dictionary (floating: double-click inserts, stays open until you close it)
zh_CN: 查找表达式 - 打开表达式字典（浮动窗口：双击插入，在你关闭之前一直保持打开）

keys: Double-click to insert at the cursor - the dictionary stays open so results chain. You can also just type in the field: the same expressions autocomplete as you go.
zh_CN: 双击即可在光标处插入 - 字典保持打开，方便连续插入。你也可以直接在字段中输入：同样的表达式会随输入自动补全。

keys: Name a counter that runs 0, 1, 2... each pass. Read it with the Loop Index expression; give nested loops distinct names and read an outer one with Loop Index Of.
zh_CN: 给一个每轮从 0, 1, 2... 递增的计数器命名。用 Loop Index 表达式读取它；给嵌套循环起不同的名字，用 Loop Index Of 读取外层循环。

keys: Write one value per line (multi-line enum)
zh_CN: 每行写一个值（多行枚举）

keys: Off: enum State { IDLE, RUN }. On: each value on its own tab-indented line - the usual shape for long enums with explicit numbers.
zh_CN: 关闭时：enum State { IDLE, RUN }。开启时：每个值单独占一行并以制表符缩进 - 带显式数字的长枚举的常见写法。
制作你自己的数据资产

keys: Sheets aren't only for gameplay: Sheet > New Custom Resource… asks three plain questions (what one entry is called, what columns it has, whether it's required) and builds a data asset whose Inspector is a fill-in table - loot tables, dialogue lines, wave plans. Designers fill rows and save .tres variants; your sheets load them. And Sheet > New Editor Tool… makes one-click editor chores the same way.
zh_CN: 事件表不只服务于玩法：Sheet > New Custom Resource… 会问三个简单问题（一条条目叫什么、有哪些列、是否必填），然后构建一个 Inspector 变成填写表格的数据资产 - 掉落表、对话台词、波次计划。设计师填写行并保存 .tres 变体；你的事件表加载它们。Sheet > New Editor Tool… 也以同样的方式生成一键编辑器杂务。

keys: Peek at Sheet > New Custom Resource… (Esc closes it without creating anything).
zh_CN: 看一眼 Sheet > New Custom Resource…（按 Esc 关闭，不会创建任何内容）。

keys: An On <Signal> event is added to the node's sheet; its actions run when the signal fires.
zh_CN: On <Signal> 事件将添加到节点的事件表中；信号触发时执行其动作。

keys: Connected %s - add actions to the new event.
zh_CN: 已连接 %s - 请为新事件添加动作。

keys: Open the EventSheet workspace to connect signals.
zh_CN: 请打开 EventSheet 工作区以连接信号。

keys: Wrap the selection in [color=...] (edit the hex after)
zh_CN: 用 [color=...] 包裹所选内容（之后可修改颜色）
选择使用此项的所有事件

keys: New field on this data class
leave empty to make it required

zh_CN: 例如 重新烘焙（留空 = 无按钮）

keys: What this verb is called. Write it in plain words - "Take Damage" becomes take_damage in the generated GDScript. Other rows call the verb by this name.
zh_CN: 这个动词叫什么。用平实的词语书写 - "Take Damage" 在生成的 GDScript 中会变成 take_damage。其他行通过这个名称调用该动词。

keys: Godot's own documentation for this verb. It is written above the function as ## lines and shows up in the editor's built-in help and when hovering the verb elsewhere. Optional.
zh_CN: 这个动词的 Godot 原生文档。它以 ## 行的形式写在函数上方，会出现在编辑器的内置帮助中，以及悬停该动词时。可选。

keys: Puts a clickable button on this node's Inspector panel, labelled with whatever you type here. Pressing it runs this verb right there in the editor - handy for chores like re-baking a level or filling in test data. Leave it empty (the usual case) and no button appears.
zh_CN: 在该节点的 Inspector 面板上放置一个可点击按钮，标签就是你在这里输入的文字。按下它会直接在编辑器中运行这个动词 - 适合重新烘焙关卡、填充测试数据这类杂活。留空（通常情况）则不会出现按钮。

keys: One line saying what this verb does. It shows beside the verb in the picker, so it is what somebody reads when deciding whether this is the verb they want.
zh_CN: 一句话说明这个动词做什么。它显示在选择器中动词的旁边，也就是别人判断这是不是自己要用的动词时读到的内容。

keys: The friendly name shown in the picker instead of the function name - "Deal Damage" reads better than deal_damage. Leave it empty to let it default from the verb name.
zh_CN: 在选择器中代替函数名显示的友好名称 - "Deal Damage" 比 deal_damage 更好读。留空则从动词名自动生成。

keys: Which section of the picker files this verb. Verbs sharing a category are grouped together, so a pack usually puts all of its verbs under one - its own name works well.
zh_CN: 这个动词归入选择器的哪个分区。同一分类的动词会归在一起，所以一个包通常把自己所有的动词放在同一个分类下 - 用包自己的名字就很合适。

keys: What kind of value this input accepts - a number (int / float), text (String), a true/false (bool), a position (Vector2 / Vector3), or Variant for anything at all.
zh_CN: 这个输入接受什么类型的值 - 数字（int / float）、文本（String）、true/false（bool）、坐标（Vector2 / Vector3），或者用 Variant 接受任何东西。

keys: An optional starting value, so whoever uses the verb can skip this input. Written as GDScript (10, 1.5, "idle", true). GDScript requires inputs WITH a default to come last, so filling this in may move the parameter down.
zh_CN: 可选的初始值，让使用该动词的人可以跳过这个输入。按 GDScript 书写（10、1.5、"idle"、true）。GDScript 要求带默认值的输入排在最后，所以填了这里可能会把该参数往下移。

keys: One line explaining this input. It shows in the picker beside the field, which is where somebody decides what to type into it.
zh_CN: 解释这个输入的一句话。它显示在选择器中该字段旁边，也就是别人决定往里填什么的地方。

keys: Each parameter has a name, type, optional default value, and description.
zh_CN: 每个参数都有名称、类型、可选的默认值和说明。

keys: A GDScript boolean expression - the body runs only when all hold (e.g. host.enabled).
zh_CN: 一个 GDScript 布尔表达式 - 只有全部成立时才会执行主体（例如 host.enabled）。

keys: Publishes the verb into pickers as the chosen kind.
zh_CN: 以所选的种类把该动词发布到选择器中。

keys: Optional default value (a GDScript expression). Defaulted params must come last.
zh_CN: 可选的默认值（一个 GDScript 表达式）。带默认值的参数必须排在最后。

keys: Function names must be valid identifiers (e.g. take_damage).
zh_CN: 函数名必须是有效的标识符（例如 take_damage）。

keys: Publish to the picker (other sheets can use it)
zh_CN: 发布到选择器（其他表可以使用）

keys: Drag this label sideways to scrub the value (Shift = fine, Ctrl = coarse).
zh_CN: 左右拖动此标签可调整数值 (Shift = 精细, Ctrl = 粗略)。

keys: (no backups yet - they appear from the second save on)
zh_CN: （尚无备份 - 从第二次保存开始出现）
主版本 - 不兼容变更

keys: No actions or conditions were found on the dropped node.
zh_CN: 在拖放的节点上未找到动作或条件。

keys: Instantiates a scene into an off-screen viewport, lets it settle for a frame, and saves what it shows as a PNG - thumbnails, store shots, doc figures, baked sprites. Needs a windowed editor: a headless run has no renderer, so it warns and writes nothing.
zh_CN: 把场景实例化到一个屏幕外视口中，让它稳定一帧，再把显示出来的画面保存为 PNG：缩略图、商店截图、文档配图、烘焙精灵。需要带窗口的编辑器：无头运行没有渲染器，因此只会给出警告，不写入任何文件。

keys: Rolls a weighted table many times and reports what actually came out: per entry the rolled percent, the percent its weight implies, and the gap between them. Pure maths - it runs anywhere, and the same seed always gives the same numbers.
zh_CN: 对一张带权重的表格反复抽取，并报告实际抽到了什么：每一条给出抽中的百分比、权重所对应的百分比，以及两者之间的差距。纯粹的算术：到哪里都能跑，同一个种子永远给出同样的数字。

keys: Runs while a project export is starting, before the files are written - the place to stamp a build number, bake a data file, or strip debug content.
zh_CN: 在项目导出开始、文件写出之前运行：用来打上构建号、烘焙数据文件，或剔除调试内容的地方。

keys: Writes a small build stamp file: the version string plus the date and time the stamp was written. The timestamp is read when the tool runs, so the generated code stays identical every save.
zh_CN: 写出一个小小的构建戳文件：版本字符串，加上写入戳记的日期和时间。时间在工具运行时才读取，所以每次保存生成的代码都完全一致。

keys: True when the export that triggered this bake step is a debug build. Use it inside On Project Export to keep test content out of release builds.
zh_CN: 当触发这一烘焙步骤的导出是调试构建时为真。放在项目导出时里面使用，把测试内容挡在正式构建之外。

keys: True when the export preset that triggered this bake step carries the given feature tag - the way to bake different data for mobile, web or desktop.
zh_CN: 当触发这一烘焙步骤的导出预设带有指定的特性标签时为真：这是为移动端、网页或桌面端烘焙不同数据的方式。

keys: Turns any value into one compact line of text a player can paste anywhere - a seed, a loadout, a whole save. Read it back with Value From Share Code.
zh_CN: 把任意值变成一行紧凑的文本，玩家可以粘贴到任何地方 - 一个随机种子、一套配装、整个存档。用 分享码的值 读回来。

keys: Anything - a run seed, a loadout list, a colour, a whole save record.
zh_CN: 任何东西 - 一次游戏的种子、一份配装清单、一个颜色、一整条存档记录。

keys: Encodes any value as a share code and puts it straight on the operating system clipboard, ready to paste.
zh_CN: 把任意值编码成分享码，并直接放进操作系统剪贴板，随时可以粘贴。

keys: copy share code for [b]{value}[/b] to clipboard
zh_CN: 复制 [b]{value}[/b] 的分享码到剪贴板

keys: Anything - a run seed, a loadout list, a whole save record.
zh_CN: 任何东西 - 一次游戏的种子、一份配装清单、一整条存档记录。

keys: True when the text really is a share code that decodes cleanly, so a paste box can refuse garbage before it reaches the game. Ask it when the pasted text CHANGES (a Paste button, On Text Changed) rather than every frame: a code mangled in transit can still reach the decoder, and the engine logs a line each time it is refused. A code that was made from nothing at all also reads as invalid.
zh_CN: 当这段文本确实是一个能够干净解码的分享码时为真，这样粘贴框就能在垃圾内容进入游戏之前把它拒之门外。请在粘贴的文本「发生变化」时询问（粘贴按钮、文本变化时），而不是每一帧都问：传输中被截断的码仍会到达解码器，而引擎每次拒绝都会打印一行。由空值生成的码同样读作无效。

keys: The pasted text to test - usually Clipboard Text or a paste box's text.
zh_CN: 要检查的粘贴文本 - 通常是 剪贴板文本 或粘贴框里的文本。

keys: Reads the value back out of a share code, giving nothing when the text is not a valid code.
zh_CN: 从分享码里把值读回来；文本不是有效的码时什么也不给。

keys: The share code text to read - check it with Share Code Is Valid first.
zh_CN: 要读取的分享码文本 - 请先用 分享码有效 检查它。

keys: True when the operating system clipboard currently holds any text - gate a paste box on it.
zh_CN: 当操作系统剪贴板中当前有任何文本时为真 - 用它来决定粘贴框是否可用。

keys: True when the operating system clipboard currently holds an image, such as a screenshot the player just copied.
zh_CN: 当操作系统剪贴板中当前有图片时为真，例如玩家刚刚复制的截图。

keys: The image currently on the operating system clipboard - feed it to ImageTexture.create_from_image to show it.
zh_CN: 当前位于操作系统剪贴板中的图片 - 交给 ImageTexture.create_from_image 即可显示。

keys: Compares whatever text is on the clipboard against a value, with your choice of operator.
zh_CN: 用你选择的运算符，把剪贴板中的文本与一个值作比较。

keys: Text to compare the clipboard against.
zh_CN: 用来与剪贴板比较的文本。

keys: Copies a live node, adds the copy to a parent, places it and optionally puts it in a group - the one-row form of Duplicate Node plus Add Child plus Set Position. Use Spawn Scene when you are starting from a .tscn file instead.
zh_CN: 复制一个活的节点，把副本加到某个父节点下，摆好位置，还可以顺便加入一个组 - 相当于 复制节点 加 添加子节点 加 设置位置 的一行写法。如果你是从 .tscn 文件出发，请改用 生成场景。
把 [i]{source}[/i] 克隆到 [i]{parent}[/i] 的 [b]{at}[/b]，组 [b]{group}[/b]

keys: World position for the copy (a Vector3 for a 3D node). Only used when the copy has a position.
zh_CN: 副本的世界坐标（3D 节点用 Vector3）。只有当副本本身带位置时才会使用。

keys: Optional group for the copy (blank = none).
zh_CN: 副本可选加入的组（留空表示不加）。

keys: Copies any value aside under a name, in memory, for this run - the before-value for a preview, a buff or a cutscene. For memory that survives closing the game use Remember Between Runs on the variable, or the Save System pack.
zh_CN: 把任意值以一个名字暂存在内存里，只在本次运行期间有效 - 预览、增益或过场动画之前的那个值。若需要关掉游戏后仍然保留，请在变量上使用 跨次运行记住，或使用存档系统包。

keys: Any label you also use in Restore Value Into.
zh_CN: 任意标签，在 恢复值到 中要用同一个。

keys: Pours a remembered value back into a variable. When nothing was remembered under that name the variable keeps what it already had.
zh_CN: 把记住的值倒回变量里。如果这个名字下什么都没记过，变量保持原样。

keys: The label used in Remember Value As.
zh_CN: 在 记住值为 中使用的标签。

keys: Variable that receives the remembered value (left alone when nothing was remembered).
zh_CN: 接收记住值的变量（如果没有记过，则原样不动）。

keys: The value remembered under a name this run, or your fallback when there is none - read it without pouring it back.
zh_CN: 本次运行中以该名字记住的值；没有就给你指定的备用值 - 只读取，不倒回去。

keys: What you get when nothing was remembered under that name.
zh_CN: 该名字下什么都没记过时，你会得到的值。

keys: True when something was remembered under that name this run - the gate on a Cancel button that should only undo a preview it actually took.
zh_CN: 本次运行中该名字下确实记过东西时为真 - 用作「取消」按钮的条件，只撤销真正做过的预览。

keys: Drops a remembered value, so Has Remembered reads false again. Forgetting a name that was never remembered is harmless.
zh_CN: 丢掉一个记住的值，于是 已记住 又变回假。忘记一个从未记过的名字没有任何副作用。

keys: Loads every data asset (.tres) in a folder as a list, so a folder of files becomes your content - items, enemies, levels, or a mod folder. A missing folder gives an empty list, and a file that fails to load is left out rather than arriving as nothing.
zh_CN: 把一个文件夹里所有数据资产（.tres）作为列表加载，于是「一个文件夹」就是你的内容 - 道具、敌人、关卡，或者玩家放 MOD 的目录。文件夹不存在就给空列表；加载失败的文件会被剔除，而不是变成一个空值混进来。

keys: Folder to scan (not recursive). Every .tres / .res inside it is loaded, in the folder's own order.
zh_CN: 要扫描的文件夹（不递归）。其中每个 .tres / .res 都会按文件夹自身顺序加载。

keys: Fetches one data asset out of a folder by its file name, or nothing at all when there is no such file - no red error.
zh_CN: 按文件名从文件夹里取出一个数据资产；没有这个文件就什么也不给 - 不会报红色错误。
存放数据资产的文件夹。

keys: File name WITHOUT the .tres extension - "rusty_sword" finds rusty_sword.tres.
zh_CN: 不带 .tres 扩展名的文件名 - "rusty_sword" 会找到 rusty_sword.tres。
加载资源否则用默认值

keys: Loads a file and hands back your fallback when it is missing, so a deleted or mod-supplied file never crashes the game.
zh_CN: 加载一个文件；文件不在时返回你指定的备用值，这样被删掉的或 MOD 提供的文件永远不会让游戏崩溃。

keys: Full path to the resource or scene to load.
zh_CN: 要加载的资源或场景的完整路径。

keys: What to use instead when the file is not there (a preloaded default, or null).
zh_CN: 文件不存在时改用什么（一个预加载的默认值，或 null）。

keys: How many data assets a folder holds, counted without loading any of them - zero if the folder is missing.
zh_CN: 一个文件夹里有多少数据资产，数的时候一个都不加载 - 文件夹不存在则为 0。

keys: Folder to count data assets in (not recursive).
zh_CN: 在其中统计数据资产的文件夹（不递归）。

keys: Makes a private copy of a resource, right down to the resources inside it, so writing to the copy never changes the .tres on disk or any other node holding it. Use this before a node edits its own stats.
zh_CN: 为资源做一份私有副本，连它内部的子资源一起复制，因此写副本永远不会改动磁盘上的 .tres，也不会影响持有同一份资源的其他节点。让节点改自己的数值之前，先来这一步。

keys: The resource to copy. Anything that is not a resource (including nothing at all) gives nothing back.
zh_CN: 要复制的资源。凡是不是资源的东西（包括空值）都不会返回任何内容。

keys: Makes a cheap copy whose own fields are separate but whose inner resources and lists are still SHARED with the original. Pick this only when you want that sharing - otherwise use Copy Resource (Independent).
zh_CN: 做一份廉价副本：它自己的字段是独立的，但内部的子资源和列表仍与原件「共享」。只有确实需要这种共享时才选它 - 否则请用 复制资源（独立）。

keys: Copies the array AND every list or dictionary nested inside it, so editing the copy cannot reach back into the original. Copy Array only copies the outer level.
zh_CN: 复制数组以及其中嵌套的每一个列表和字典，因此改副本绝不会波及原件。复制数组 只复制最外层。

keys: Array variable to copy right through.
zh_CN: 要彻底复制的数组变量。

keys: Copies the dictionary AND every list or dictionary nested inside it, so editing the copy cannot reach back into the original. Copy Dictionary only copies the outer level.
zh_CN: 复制字典以及其中嵌套的每一个列表和字典，因此改副本绝不会波及原件。复制字典 只复制最外层。

keys: Dictionary variable to copy right through.
zh_CN: 要彻底复制的字典变量。

keys: Pours a list of values off another object onto this one, in one row instead of one row per property. Names the target does not have are skipped, so a single preset can serve several kinds of node.
zh_CN: 把另一个对象上的一串数值倒到这个对象上，一行搞定，而不是每个属性写一行。目标没有的名字会跳过，因此同一份预设可以服务多种节点。

keys: The object being written to - it is what changes.
zh_CN: 被写入的对象 - 发生变化的是它。

keys: The object to read from - a node OR a resource.
zh_CN: 读取来源对象 - 可以是节点，也可以是资源。

keys: Comma-separated property names. Leave blank to copy every variable the source's script declares.
zh_CN: 用逗号分隔的属性名。留空则复制来源脚本声明的所有变量。

keys: Writes a base's values ONLY into fields this object left empty, leaving everything you did fill in alone. That is the override chain: a base item plus a rarity variant, or a shipped table plus a mod file. Empty means nothing there: no value at all, blank text, an empty list or an empty record - a 0 and a false are real values and are kept, exactly as Is Nothing and Missing Fields read them.
zh_CN: 只把基准对象的值写进这个对象留空的字段，你已经填好的一律不动。这就是覆盖链：基础道具加稀有度变体，或内置表格加 MOD 文件。「空」指的是什么都没有：没有值、空文本、空列表、空记录。0 和 false 是真实的值，会被保留 - 与 什么都没有 和 缺失的字段 的读法完全一致。
用 [i]{base}[/i] 填补 [i]{target}[/i] 的空缺

keys: The one being completed - it is what changes.
zh_CN: 被补全的那个 - 发生变化的是它。

keys: Where the missing values come from.
Pours a data asset's fields onto the same-named properties of a node, so difficulty tiers, weapon tunings and boss phases become a data edit instead of a wall of rows.
zh_CN: 把数据资产里的字段倒进节点上同名的属性，于是难度档位、武器数值、Boss 阶段变成改数据，而不是堆一墙的行。

keys: The data asset to pour on (a .tres you filled in the Inspector). Nothing happens if it is empty.
zh_CN: 要倒进去的数据资产（你在检查器里填好的 .tres）。为空则什么都不做。

keys: The node to apply it to.

True while the listed properties hold the same values on both objects - the cheap 'is this ghost still in sync' or 'has anything changed' check. A name neither object has reads as NOT matching, so a typo shows up instead of quietly passing, and either side being gone reads as not matching too.
zh_CN: 只要列出的属性在两个对象上取值相同就为真 - 这是「这个残影还同步吗」「有什么变了吗」的廉价检查。两个对象都没有的名字读作「不匹配」，所以拼错会暴露出来而不是悄悄通过；任何一边已经消失也读作不匹配。

keys: Comma-separated property names to compare. A blank list has nothing to compare, so it is true.
zh_CN: 用逗号分隔、要比较的属性名。空列表没有可比的内容，因此为真。

keys: True when a loaded record was written by an older build than this one - the gate a migration sits under. A record with NO version field counts as 0, so the very first format upgrades too, and so does one whose version field is empty or is not a number at all.
zh_CN: 当加载到的记录是由比当前更旧的构建写下时为真 - 迁移就挂在这个条件下。「没有」版本字段的记录按 0 计，所以最初的那版格式也会被升级；版本字段为空或根本不是数字时同理。

keys: The parsed record (a save file, a payload, a manifest).
zh_CN: 已解析的记录（存档文件、传输载荷、清单）。

keys: Which field holds the version number.
Moves a value to its new field name, and does nothing at all when the old name is not there - so a migration is safe to run twice.
zh_CN: 把一个值搬到新的字段名下；旧名字不存在时什么都不做 - 所以迁移跑两遍也安全。
在 [i]{record}[/i] 中把 [b]{from_field}[/b] 改名为 [b]{to_field}[/b]

keys: The record to migrate, edited in place.
zh_CN: 要迁移的记录，就地修改。

keys: The new field name (overwritten if it is already there).
zh_CN: 新的字段名（如果已存在会被覆盖）。

keys: Writes the current format number onto a record, so the next load knows it has already been migrated. Data Is Older Than Version reads it back, and reads it as 0 when it is missing or is not a number.
zh_CN: 把当前格式号写到记录上，这样下次加载就知道它已经迁移过了。数据早于版本 会读回这个号；缺失或不是数字时按 0 读。

keys: The version this build writes - a whole number.
zh_CN: 当前构建写入的版本 - 一个整数。

keys: Reads a .csv whose FIRST line is the column names and gives you one record per row, each field reachable by column name - row["price"]. Quoted cells may contain the separator, Windows line endings are fine, and a missing file simply gives no rows. Store it in an Array variable, then walk it with a For Each pick filter.
zh_CN: 读取「第一行是列名」的 .csv，每行给你一条记录，每个字段都能按列名取用 - row["price"]。带引号的单元格里可以含分隔符，Windows 换行没问题，文件不存在就是没有行。把结果存进数组变量，再用 For Each 挑选过滤器逐行处理。

keys: The .csv to read. Its FIRST line must be the column names.
zh_CN: 要读取的 .csv。它的第一行必须是列名。

keys: What separates the columns in that file.
zh_CN: 该文件中用什么分隔各列。

keys: The same column-names-first parse as Table From File, but over text you already hold instead of a file on disk.
zh_CN: 与 从文件读表 相同的「首行是列名」解析，只是作用在你手上已有的文本，而不是磁盘上的文件。

keys: Spreadsheet text you already have - a pasted blob, a downloaded body, a file you read earlier. FIRST line = the column names.
zh_CN: 你手上已有的表格文本 - 粘贴进来的一大块、下载到的正文、之前读进来的文件。第一行 = 列名。

keys: Gives one whole column as a list, in row order - handy for a dropdown's items, a weights list, or a quick sum. A row missing that column contributes empty text.
zh_CN: 把一整列按行序作为列表返回 - 用来填下拉菜单、权重列表或快速求和都很顺手。缺这一列的行贡献一个空文本。

keys: The rows-of-records variable a Table From File (or Table From Text) expression filled.
zh_CN: 由 从文件读表（或 从文本读表）表达式填好的「一行一记录」变量。

keys: The column name to read, exactly as it is spelled in the header row.
zh_CN: 要读取的列名，拼写要与表头行完全一致。

keys: Finds the FIRST record whose column holds this value - the single-item lookup, e.g. the row for item "sword". Gives an empty record when nothing matches, so check it with Dictionary Is Empty before reading fields.
zh_CN: 找出该列取值等于这个值的「第一条」记录 - 单条查询，比如道具 "sword" 那一行。没有匹配时返回空记录，所以读取字段前请用 字典为空 检查一下。

keys: The column to match on, exactly as it is spelled in the header row.
zh_CN: 用来匹配的列，拼写要与表头行完全一致。

keys: The value to look for. Compared as text, so 25 and "25" both match a cell reading 25.
zh_CN: 要查找的值。按文本比较，所以 25 和 "25" 都能匹配写着 25 的单元格。

keys: Runs this event's actions once per LINE of the text, skipping blank ones. Windows (CRLF) and old-Mac (CR) endings are handled, so no line arrives with a stray carriage return. Read the current one as `line`.
zh_CN: 对文本的每一「行」执行一次本事件的动作，空行跳过。Windows（CRLF）和旧 Mac（CR）换行都会处理，所以不会有行带着多余的回车符进来。当前行读作 `line`。

keys: The text to walk line by line - a file you read, a pasted blob, a leaderboard body.
zh_CN: 要逐行遍历的文本 - 读进来的文件、粘贴的一大块、排行榜正文等。

keys: Runs this event's actions once per PIECE of the text. Each piece arrives with its surrounding spaces trimmed, and empty pieces are skipped, so "sword; shield;; bow" is three parts. Read the current one as `part`.
zh_CN: 对文本的每一「段」执行一次本事件的动作。每段到手时已去掉前后空格，空段会跳过，所以 "sword; shield;; bow" 是三段。当前段读作 `part`。

keys: for each part of [b]{text}[/b] split by [b]{separator}[/b]
zh_CN: 对以 [b]{separator}[/b] 分隔的 [b]{text}[/b] 的每一段

keys: The text to break up - a tag list, a chat command's arguments, one cell of a spreadsheet.
zh_CN: 要拆开的文本 - 一串标签、一条聊天指令的参数、表格中的一个单元格。

keys: What separates the pieces, e.g. "," or ";" or " ".
zh_CN: 用什么分隔各段，例如 "," 或 ";" 或 " "。
对文件夹中的每个资源

keys: Runs this event's actions once per data asset (.tres / .res) in a folder, already loaded - the "a folder of items IS my item list" setup, with no list to maintain. A folder that is not there walks nothing (quietly - it is checked first, so a loop that runs every frame cannot spam errors), and anything that fails to load is skipped rather than arriving as null. Read the current one as `entry`.
zh_CN: 对文件夹里每个数据资产（.tres / .res）执行一次本事件的动作，并且已经加载好 - 这就是「一个道具文件夹就是我的道具清单」的做法，没有清单需要维护。文件夹不存在时什么也不遍历（而且很安静 - 会先检查，所以每帧运行的循环也不会刷屏报错）；加载失败的会被跳过，而不是变成 null 送进来。当前项读作 `entry`。

keys: Folder of data assets to walk. Only .tres / .res files are loaded; anything else in there is ignored.
zh_CN: 要遍历的数据资产文件夹。只加载 .tres / .res 文件，其他一律忽略。

keys: The part of the text before the first marker: Text Before("Ada [angry]: hi", " [") is "Ada". When the marker is not there you get the whole text back, so nothing is silently lost.
zh_CN: 第一个标记之前的那部分文本：之前的文本("Ada [angry]: hi", " [") 是 "Ada"。标记不存在时会把整段文本还给你，所以不会悄悄丢东西。

keys: The line to read a piece out of.
zh_CN: 要从中取出一段的那一行。

keys: The marker to stop at (the first one wins).
zh_CN: 在此停下的标记（以第一个为准）。

keys: Everything after the first marker: Text After("Ada [angry]: hi", "]: ") is "hi". Empty when the marker is not there, because then there is no "after".
zh_CN: 第一个标记之后的全部内容：之后的文本("Ada [angry]: hi", "]: ") 是 "hi"。标记不存在时为空，因为那时根本没有「之后」。

keys: The marker to start after (the first one wins).
zh_CN: 从其之后开始的标记（以第一个为准）。

keys: The part between two markers: Text Between("Ada [angry]: hi", "[", "]") is "angry". Empty when the opening marker is missing, and the rest of the text when the closing one is.
zh_CN: 两个标记之间的那部分：之间的文本("Ada [angry]: hi", "[", "]") 是 "angry"。缺开头标记时为空；缺结尾标记时给你余下的全部文本。
{text} 中 {open} 与 {close} 之间的部分

keys: The first number found anywhere in the text, whole or decimal: "Chapter 3" gives 3, "v1.25-beta" gives 1.25. You get 0 when there is no number at all, and you never write a pattern.
zh_CN: 文本中任何位置出现的第一个数字，整数或小数皆可："Chapter 3" 得到 3，"v1.25-beta" 得到 1.25。完全没有数字时得到 0，而且你永远不用写正则。

keys: Text that has a number somewhere in it.

zh_CN: 拆分并保留引号内内容

keys: Splits text on a separator but keeps anything inside "double quotes" together as one piece, and drops the quotes: give "iron sword" 2 is three pieces, not four. Empty pieces are skipped, so runs of separators never produce blanks.
zh_CN: 按分隔符拆分文本，但把 "双引号" 里的内容当作一整块保留下来，并去掉引号：give "iron sword" 2 是三段而不是四段。空段会被跳过，所以连续的分隔符不会产生空白项。
{text} 的各段（引号内保持完整）

keys: The line to split - a console entry, a search box, a pasted cell.
zh_CN: 要拆分的那一行 - 控制台输入、搜索框、粘贴过来的单元格。

keys: What separates the pieces OUTSIDE quotes.
zh_CN: 在引号「之外」用什么分隔各段。

keys: Why this JSON failed to parse, with the line: "line 4: Expected ':'". Empty when it parses fine, so an empty result IS the all-clear. Log it and the bug report writes itself. Branch on this expression's own emptiness (Text Is Blank, inverted) rather than on JSON Is Valid: that condition reads a file holding just the word null as invalid, and this one has nothing to say about it, so pairing them logs an error with a blank reason.
zh_CN: 这段 JSON 为什么解析失败，并带上行号："line 4: Expected ':'"。解析正常时为空，所以「空结果」就是一切正常。把它打进日志，缺陷报告等于自己写好了。请按「本表达式自身是否为空」来分支（文本为空白 取反），而不要用 JSON 有效：那个条件把只写着 null 一个词的文件读作无效，而本表达式对此无话可说，两者搭配就会记下一条没有原因的错误。

keys: The JSON text to check - a file you read, a paste, a server reply.
zh_CN: 要检查的 JSON 文本 - 读进来的文件、粘贴的内容、服务器返回的响应。

keys: The first cell of a table that should be a number and is not, said out loud: "row 12, column "price": "abc" is not a number". Rows are counted from 1 over the rows you hold - Table From File has already used up the header line, so row 12 is line 13 of the file. A row that is not a record at all is reported too. Empty when every listed column checks out.
zh_CN: 表格中第一个「本该是数字却不是」的单元格，用一句话说出来："row 12, column "price": "abc" is not a number"。行号是对你手上的行从 1 开始数的 - 从文件读表 已经用掉了表头那一行，所以 row 12 是文件的第 13 行。压根不是记录的行也会被报出来。列出的每一列都没问题时结果为空。

keys: A list of records - one per row, each field reachable by column name.
zh_CN: 一串记录 - 每行一条，每个字段都能按列名取用。

keys: The columns that must hold numbers.
zh_CN: 必须存放数字的那些列。

keys: The listed fields that are missing or left blank, comma-separated, and empty when the record is complete. Blank means nothing there: null, empty text, an empty list or an empty record - a 0 is a real value and is never reported.
zh_CN: 列出的字段中缺失或留空的那些，用逗号连起来；记录完整时结果为空。「空」指的是什么都没有：null、空文本、空列表、空记录。0 是真实的值，永远不会被报出来。

keys: A record or a resource to check.
The fields it must have filled in, separated by commas.
zh_CN: 它必须填好的字段，用逗号分隔。

keys: Trims text to a maximum number of characters and marks the cut with the ending you choose, so a clipped name never reads as the whole name. Text that already fits comes back untouched, and the result never runs past the width you gave - a width too narrow to hold the ending simply cuts without one. Cuts mid-word: use Shorten To Whole Words when the cut should land on a word boundary.
zh_CN: 把文本裁到最多多少个字符，并用你选的结尾符号标出裁切，这样被截断的名字绝不会读起来像完整的名字。本来就放得下的文本原样返回，结果也绝不会超出你给的宽度 - 窄到连结尾符号都放不下时，就直接不带符号裁掉。它会从词中间裁开：想让裁切落在词边界上，请用 按整词缩短。
把 [b]{text}[/b] 缩短到 [b]{max_chars}[/b] 个字符

keys: The text that has to fit.
zh_CN: 必须放得下的那段文本。

keys: The widest the result may get, in characters, counting the ending below.
zh_CN: 结果最多可以有多宽（按字符数），并把下面的结尾符号算在内。

keys: What marks the cut, e.g. "..." or a single ellipsis character. Its own length is taken out of the budget.
zh_CN: 用什么标示裁切，例如 "..." 或一个省略号字符。它自身的长度会从预算里扣掉。

keys: Like Shorten To Fit, but backs up to the last complete word before cutting, so "Ancient Sword of Thorns" reads "Ancient Sword..." instead of "Ancient Sword of Th". When the budget holds no whole word (one very long word) it falls back to cutting by characters, and when it is too narrow to hold the ending at all it cuts without one - so the result is never just the ending, and never wider than you asked for.
zh_CN: 与 缩短到放得下 一样，但在裁切前会退回到最后一个完整单词，因此 "Ancient Sword of Thorns" 读作 "Ancient Sword..." 而不是 "Ancient Sword of Th"。当预算里放不下任何完整单词时（比如只有一个很长的单词），它退回到按字符裁切；窄到连结尾符号都放不下时就不带符号裁 - 所以结果绝不会只剩结尾符号，也绝不会超过你要求的宽度。
在 [b]{max_chars}[/b] 之内把 [b]{text}[/b] 按整词缩短

keys: Turns a number into grouped digits a player can take in at a glance: 1234567 reads "1,234,567". Whole numbers only (the fraction is dropped); a negative keeps its minus sign. For idle-game scale (1.23e15, "1.23 Qa") reach for the Big Numbers pack instead.
zh_CN: 把数字变成玩家一眼就能读懂的分组数位：1234567 读作 "1,234,567"。只处理整数（小数部分会被丢弃）；负数保留减号。要处理放置类游戏的量级（1.23e15、"1.23 Qa"），请改用「大数字」包。

keys: The number to make readable. Anything after the decimal point is dropped.
zh_CN: 要变得易读的数字。小数点后的部分会被丢弃。

keys: Turns a fraction into percent TEXT with the sign on it: 0.73 reads "73%". Feed it a 0-to-1 value (Percent Of already returns 0-to-100, so divide that by 100 or use the raw fraction).
zh_CN: 把一个比例变成带百分号的「文本」：0.73 读作 "73%"。请喂给它 0 到 1 之间的值（占比 已经返回 0 到 100，所以要么除以 100，要么直接用原始比例）。

keys: A fraction where 1.0 means full, e.g. health / max_health.
zh_CN: 以 1.0 表示满的比例，例如 health / max_health。

keys: Digits after the decimal point. 0 gives a whole percent.
zh_CN: 小数点后保留几位。0 表示取整的百分比。

keys: Seconds as a duration that survives passing an hour: 3725 reads "1h 02m" and 90 reads "1m 30s". A negative duration reads as zero. Use As Clock Time when you want strict mm:ss (it rolls an hour into "60:00").
zh_CN: 把秒数写成超过一小时也不出错的时长：3725 读作 "1h 02m"，90 读作 "1m 30s"。负的时长按零读。想要严格的 mm:ss，请用 时钟时间（在那里一小时会变成 "60:00"）。

keys: Pads text out on the RIGHT to a fixed width, so every row starts on the same edge and reads as a column. Text longer than the width is left alone (it is never cut - shorten it first). Give the Label a MONOSPACE theme font or the column will still drift.
zh_CN: 把文本在「右侧」补齐到固定宽度，于是每一行都从同一条边开始，读起来像一列。比宽度还长的文本原样保留（永远不裁 - 请先缩短）。要给 Label 设置等宽主题字体，否则这一列还是会歪。
在 [b]{width}[/b] 宽度内左对齐的 [b]{text}[/b]

keys: Column width in characters. Shorter text is padded; longer text is left as it is.
zh_CN: 列宽（按字符数）。较短的文本会补齐，较长的原样保留。

keys: What fills the gap: a space, or "." for a dotted leader. One character.
zh_CN: 用什么填补空隙：空格，或者用 "." 做点线引导。只能是一个字符。

keys: Pads text out on the LEFT to a fixed width, so numbers END on the same edge and read as a column of figures. Text longer than the width is left alone. Give the Label a MONOSPACE theme font or the column will still drift.
zh_CN: 把文本在「左侧」补齐到固定宽度，于是数字都在同一条边「结束」，读起来像一列数目。比宽度还长的文本原样保留。要给 Label 设置等宽主题字体，否则这一列还是会歪。
在 [b]{width}[/b] 宽度内右对齐的 [b]{text}[/b]

keys: The text to pad out - str() a number first.
zh_CN: 要补齐的文本 - 数字请先用 str() 转成文本。

keys: Pads text on BOTH sides to a fixed width, so a heading sits in the middle of a column. An odd leftover space goes on the right. Text longer than the width is left alone. Give the Label a MONOSPACE theme font or the centering will still drift.
zh_CN: 把文本在「两侧」补齐到固定宽度，于是标题落在一列的正中。多出来的那一格奇数空位放到右边。比宽度还长的文本原样保留。要给 Label 设置等宽主题字体，否则居中还是会歪。

keys: Turns a machine id into a readable name: "fire_sword" reads "Fire Sword", "maxHealth" reads "Max Health". Use it wherever a key has to be shown to a player, so ids and labels never drift apart in two places.
zh_CN: 把机器用的 id 变成可读的名字："fire_sword" 读作 "Fire Sword"，"maxHealth" 读作 "Max Health"。凡是要把键展示给玩家的地方都用它，id 和显示名就不会在两处各走各的。

keys: An id or key, e.g. fire_sword or maxHealth.
zh_CN: 一个 id 或键，例如 fire_sword 或 maxHealth。

keys: Raises the FIRST letter only and leaves the rest of the text exactly as it is, so "NPC" and "HP" keep their capitals. Empty text stays empty.
zh_CN: 只把「第一个字母」变成大写，其余原封不动，因此 "NPC" 和 "HP" 仍保留它们的大写。空文本仍为空。

keys: A sentence that needs its first letter raised.
zh_CN: 需要把首字母改成大写的句子。

keys: Looks the whole sentence up in the current language FIRST, then fills its {slots}. The pattern you type here - slots and all - is the translation key, so it is what goes in the catalog. Filling the slots first (Translate around Text From Pattern) produces a string no catalog can contain, and the text then never translates.
zh_CN: 先用当前语言把整句话「查」出来，然后再填它的 {slots}。你在这里写下的模板 - 连同占位槽 - 就是翻译键，也正是要放进词条表的东西。先填槽再翻译（用 翻译 包住 由模板生成文本）会产生任何词条表都不可能包含的字符串，那段文字从此永远不会被翻译。

keys: The source sentence, with {name} slots. This exact string, slots and all, is the translation key that goes in the catalog.
zh_CN: 源句子，带 {name} 占位槽。这个字符串原封不动（含占位槽）就是要写进词条表的翻译键。

keys: What fills the slots: {"name": value, ...} - e.g. {"coins": coins}.
zh_CN: 用什么填充占位槽：{"name": value, ...} - 例如 {"coins": coins}。

keys: Sets this Label's text from a pattern that is translated FIRST and filled second. The pattern - slots and all - is the translation key. Re-run it under On Language Changed so the label follows a live language switch.
zh_CN: 用「先翻译、后填槽」的模板来设置这个 Label 的文本。模板（连同占位槽）就是翻译键。把它放在 语言变化时 下再跑一次，标签就能跟上运行中的语言切换。

keys: True when this text would convert to a number cleanly. Ask it BEFORE converting, so a typo can never arrive as a silent 0 and the sheet bet nothing. Spaces around the number are ignored; empty text is not a number.
zh_CN: 当这段文本能够干净地转成数字时为真。请在转换「之前」先问，这样打错的输入就不会悄悄变成 0，让整张表押上了个「什么都没有」。数字前后的空格会忽略；空文本不是数字。

keys: Text to test - a typed-in field, a value read back out of a save, a CSV or JSON cell.
zh_CN: 要检查的文本 - 手输的输入框、从存档读回的值、CSV 或 JSON 里的一格。

keys: True when this text would convert to a WHOLE number cleanly - a count, a level, a slot index. "12" passes and "12.5" does not, which is the only difference from Text Is A Number.
zh_CN: 当这段文本能够干净地转成「整数」时为真 - 数量、等级、槽位序号。"12" 通过而 "12.5" 不通过，这也是它与 文本是数字 唯一的差别。

keys: Text to test - a count, a level number, a save slot, a seed.
zh_CN: 要检查的文本 - 数量、关卡编号、存档槽、随机种子。

keys: True when the text contains at least ONE of the listed pieces - a chat filter, a keyword-triggered line, a tag-gated card. Unlike Text Is One Of, which needs the WHOLE text to equal an entry, this looks INSIDE the text. Matching is case-sensitive, and an empty list is never a match.
zh_CN: 当文本包含所列片段中的「至少一个」时为真 - 聊天过滤、由关键词触发的台词、靠标签解锁的卡牌。与要求「整段文本」等于某一项的 文本是其中之一 不同，这个是往文本「里面」看。匹配区分大小写，空列表永远不算命中。

keys: List of pieces to look for - written here, or a sheet variable someone can edit without touching this row.
zh_CN: 要查找的片段列表 - 可以直接写在这里，也可以放进一个表变量，让别人不用碰这一行就能改。

keys: True only when the text contains EVERY listed piece - a combo whose rule text names two keywords, a search box where all the words must match. An empty list counts as true, because nothing is missing.
zh_CN: 只有当文本包含所列的「每一个」片段时才为真 - 规则文本里点名两个关键词的连招、要求所有词都命中的搜索框。空列表算作真，因为没有任何东西缺席。

keys: List of pieces that must ALL appear.
zh_CN: 必须「全部」出现的片段列表。

keys: True when the text contains none of the listed pieces - the accept-this-name branch, written as the thing you want to act on instead of an Else. An empty list always passes.
zh_CN: 当文本不包含所列的任何片段时为真 - 这是「接受这个名字」的分支，直接写成你想处理的那一侧，而不是写成 Else。空列表总是通过。
{text} 不包含 {options} 中任何一个

keys: List of pieces that must NOT appear.

Reads a number out of text, or hands back the fallback YOU chose - never a surprise zero. Pair it with Text Is A Number when the two cases need different rows. The text is read twice in the emitted line, so keep it a plain read and not something that changes the game.
zh_CN: 从文本里读出一个数字，读不出来就返回「你自己选的」备用值 - 绝不会冒出一个意外的 0。两种情况需要分成不同的行时，请与 文本是数字 搭配。生成的那行里这段文本会被读两次，所以请保持它是纯读取，而不是会改变游戏状态的东西。

keys: Text to read a number out of.
zh_CN: 要从中读出数字的文本。

keys: What you get back when the text is not a number.
zh_CN: 文本不是数字时你会得到的值。

keys: Reads a whole number out of text, or hands back your fallback. "12.5" is not a whole number, so it lands on the fallback rather than quietly becoming 12 - when you want that rounding, use Number From Text and round the result yourself.
zh_CN: 从文本里读出一个整数，读不出来就返回你的备用值。"12.5" 不是整数，所以它会落到备用值，而不是悄悄变成 12 - 想要那种取整，请用 从文本取数字 再自己取整。

keys: Text to read a whole number out of.
zh_CN: 要从中读出整数的文本。

keys: What you get back when the text is not a whole number.
zh_CN: 文本不是整数时你会得到的值。

keys: True when there is nothing there: no value at all, empty text, an empty list (including an empty Split Text result), or an empty record - one row whatever the value turns out to be. A 0 is NOT nothing, because a score of zero is a real value, and neither is text made only of spaces (that is Text Is Blank).
zh_CN: 当那里什么都没有时为真：根本没有值、空文本、空列表（包括 拆分文本 得到的空结果）、空记录 - 无论值最终是什么类型，都只要这一行。0 「不是」什么都没有，因为 0 分是真实的值；只由空格组成的文本也不算（那是 文本为空白）。

keys: Anything - text, a list, a record, a reference.
zh_CN: 任何东西 - 文本、列表、记录、引用。

keys: True when there IS something there - a name was typed, the inventory has items, the save slot was written, the item slot is filled. The exact opposite of Is Nothing, for the times the filled case is the one you want to act on.
zh_CN: 当那里「确实有」东西时为真 - 名字填过了、背包里有物品、存档槽写过了、道具格是满的。它是 什么都没有 的完全反面，适合你想处理「有内容」那一侧的时候。

keys: The value when it really is a number, or your own default when it is missing, null, text, or anything else. A zero counts as a real number and is kept. Use it to put a loaded value straight into a whole-number or decimal variable without a guard row first. The value is read twice in the emitted line, so keep it a plain read and not something that changes the game.
zh_CN: 当它确实是数字时给出该值；缺失、为 null、是文本或是别的什么时，给出你自己指定的默认值。0 算作真实的数字并保留下来。用它可以把加载到的值直接放进整数或小数变量，而不用先写一行守卫。生成的那行里这个值会被读两次，所以请保持它是纯读取，而不是会改变游戏状态的东西。

keys: The untyped value to check - a save slot read, a JSON field, a Dictionary key.
zh_CN: 要检查的无类型值 - 从存档槽读到的东西、JSON 字段、字典的键。

keys: What you get back when it is not a number.
zh_CN: 它不是数字时你会得到的值。

keys: The value when it really is text with something in it, or your own default when it is missing, null, blank, or another kind of value. The classic use is a saved player name that falls back to "Player". The value is read twice in the emitted line, so keep it a plain read and not something that changes the game.
zh_CN: 当它确实是有内容的文本时给出该值；缺失、为 null、为空或是别的类型时，给出你自己指定的默认值。最经典的用法是存档里的玩家名字缺失时回退到 "Player"。生成的那行里这个值会被读两次，所以请保持它是纯读取，而不是会改变游戏状态的东西。

keys: What you get back when it is not text, or is blank.
zh_CN: 它不是文本或为空时你会得到的值。

keys: The value when it really is a list with items in it, or your own default when it is missing, null, empty, or another kind of value. A Split Text result counts as a list. Safe to feed straight into a For Each. The value is read twice in the emitted line, so keep it a plain read and not something that changes the game.
zh_CN: 当它确实是有元素的列表时给出该值；缺失、为 null、为空或是别的类型时，给出你自己指定的默认值。拆分文本 的结果也算列表。可以放心直接喂给 For Each。生成的那行里这个值会被读两次，所以请保持它是纯读取，而不是会改变游戏状态的东西。

keys: The untyped value to check - a loaded inventory, a JSON array, a Split Text result, a Dictionary key.
zh_CN: 要检查的无类型值 - 加载进来的背包、JSON 数组、拆分文本 的结果、字典的键。

keys: What you get back when it is not a list, or is empty.
zh_CN: 它不是列表或为空时你会得到的值。

keys: The value when it really is a record (a dictionary) with keys in it, or your own default when it is missing, null, empty, or another kind of value. Pair it with Get Key so a whole missing settings block reads as defaults. The value is read twice in the emitted line, so keep it a plain read and not something that changes the game.
zh_CN: 当它确实是带键的记录（字典）时给出该值；缺失、为 null、为空或是别的类型时，给出你自己指定的默认值。与 取键 搭配，整块设置即使完全缺失也会按默认值读出来。生成的那行里这个值会被读两次，所以请保持它是纯读取，而不是会改变游戏状态的东西。

keys: The untyped value to check - a loaded settings block, a JSON object, a Dictionary key.
zh_CN: 要检查的无类型值 - 加载进来的设置块、JSON 对象、字典的键。

keys: What you get back when it is not a record, or is empty.
zh_CN: 它不是记录或为空时你会得到的值。

keys: The value unless it is null, in which case your own default. This one guards nothing else: a zero, a blank text and an empty list all count as real values here. Use it for a method that can hand back null. The value is read twice in the emitted line, so keep it a plain read and not something that changes the game.
zh_CN: 只要它不是 null 就给出该值；是 null 时才给出你自己指定的默认值。这一个不管别的：0、空文本、空列表在这里都算真实的值。适合用在可能返回 null 的方法上。生成的那行里这个值会被读两次，所以请保持它是纯读取，而不是会改变游戏状态的东西。

keys: Anything that might be null - a method result, a freed reference, a missing key.
zh_CN: 任何可能是 null 的东西 - 方法的返回值、已释放的引用、不存在的键。

keys: What you get back when it is null.
zh_CN: 它是 null 时你会得到的值。

keys: One named piece of a pair, a triple, a colour or a record: the up/down part of a velocity (the jump-or-fall test), the see-through part of a tint, the forward/back part of a 3D direction. Reads as a sentence instead of a typed-in .y. Pick a part the value actually has - a record that might be missing the field is the shipped Get Key (with default)'s job, because that one takes a fallback and this one does not.
zh_CN: 二元、三元、颜色或记录中一个有名字的分量：速度的上下分量（判断在跳还是在落）、色调的透明分量、3D 方向的前后分量。它读起来是一句话，而不是手写的 .y。请挑值确实拥有的分量 - 可能缺字段的记录归 取键（带默认值） 管，因为那一个接受备用值，而这一个不接受。

keys: A Vector2, Vector3, Color or record to read one part of.
zh_CN: 要从中读取一个分量的 Vector2、Vector3、Color 或记录。

keys: Changes one named part and leaves the rest alone: zero the vertical speed on landing and keep the horizontal, flatten a 3D direction to the ground plane, fade only the see-through part of a tint. Writing a part a record does not have yet ADDS it.
zh_CN: 只改一个具名分量，其余保持不动：落地时把垂直速度归零而保留水平速度、把 3D 方向压平到地面、只淡出色调的透明分量。往记录里写一个它还没有的分量，会把这个分量「添加」进去。
把 {var_name} 的 {part} 分量设为 {value}

keys: What to change one part of: a node's own member (velocity, modulate, position) picked from the list, or the name of a sheet variable holding a Vector, Color or record.
zh_CN: 要改动其中一个分量的对象：从列表里挑的节点自身成员（velocity、modulate、position），或某个存放向量、颜色或记录的表变量名。

keys: The new value for that one part.

Checks whether a data file has been written since the last check, and fires the sheet's data_file_changed(path) signal when it has - so you edit an enemy's numbers in the Inspector and the running game picks them up. Put it under Every X Seconds; the first check only takes a reading, so nothing fires just because the row started. This is a debug-build tool: it reads the file's timestamp each time it runs.
zh_CN: 检查某个数据文件自上次检查以来是否被写入过，如果是，就触发事件表的 data_file_changed(path) 信号 - 这样你在 Inspector 里改敌人的数值，运行中的游戏就能立刻用上。把它放在“每 X 秒”下面；第一次检查只是取一个读数，所以不会仅仅因为这一行开始运行就触发。这是调试版本用的工具：它每次运行都会读取文件的时间戳。

keys: The data file to watch (a .tres, .json or .csv).
zh_CN: 要监视的数据文件（.tres、.json 或 .csv）。

keys: Re-reads a data asset from disk into the copy every node is already holding, so the new numbers apply without restarting or re-assigning anything. It reloads DATA, not code: a changed script still needs a restart. Nothing happens when the path is not there.
zh_CN: 把一个数据资产从磁盘重新读入每个节点已经持有的那份副本，于是新数值无需重启、也无需重新赋值就能生效。它重新加载的是数据，不是代码：脚本改了仍然需要重启。路径不存在时什么也不会发生。

keys: The data asset to re-read from disk.
zh_CN: 要从磁盘重新读取的数据资产。

keys: Runs when a Watch Data File row notices that a watched file has been written. The path arrives on the row as path, so the reaction reloads exactly the file that changed even when two land in the same check. Needs a Signal row for data_file_changed(path: String) - without one the sheet still compiles, but nothing connects this event, so it never runs. The Project Doctor flags that.
zh_CN: 当一行“监视数据文件”发现被监视的文件被写入时运行。路径会以 path 的形式送到这一行上，所以即使两个文件在同一次检查中变化，反应也能准确地重新加载真正变化的那一个。需要一行 data_file_changed(path: String) 的信号行 - 没有它事件表仍能编译，但没有任何东西连接这个事件，所以它永远不会运行。项目 Doctor 会标记这一点。

keys: The file that was written, carried by the signal itself.
zh_CN: 被写入的那个文件，由信号本身携带。

keys: Every structural problem in a folder of data assets, one per line, and "" when it is clean: a file that cannot be loaded, one with no usable id, and two files claiming the same id (where the second quietly wins every lookup). Show it, log it, or fail a build with it.
zh_CN: 一个数据资产文件夹里的每个结构性问题，每行一条，干净时为 ""：无法加载的文件、没有可用 id 的文件，以及两个文件声明了同一个 id（此时后一个会悄悄赢下每一次查找）。可以显示它、记录它，或者用它让构建失败。

keys: Folder of data assets to check (not recursive).
zh_CN: 要检查的数据资产文件夹（不递归）。

keys: True when every data asset in a folder loads, has an id, and has an id no sibling shares - the check to put in front of loading a mod folder or user content. Read the reasons with Data Folder Problems.
zh_CN: 当一个文件夹里的每个数据资产都能加载、都有 id、且 id 不与任何同级重复时为真 - 加载 mod 文件夹或用户内容之前该放的那道检查。用“数据文件夹问题”查看具体原因。

keys: Checks a folder of data assets and writes every problem it finds to the Output as one warning, saying which file and what is wrong. A clean folder says nothing at all, so it is safe to leave in a startup event.
zh_CN: 检查一个数据资产文件夹，把发现的每个问题作为一条警告写入输出，说明是哪个文件、哪里不对。完全干净的文件夹什么也不会说，所以放在启动事件里很安全。

keys: Where a world point sits on screen right now, camera zoom and scroll included - pin a nameplate, a health bar or a damage number to something that moves. Put the answer on a node that lives on a CanvasLayer and it will track its target without lagging behind the camera.
zh_CN: 一个世界坐标点此刻在屏幕上的位置，已经算上摄像机的缩放和滚动 - 把名牌、血条或伤害数字钉在会移动的东西上。把结果用在位于 CanvasLayer 上的节点上，它就能跟住目标，而不会落后于摄像机。

keys: A position in the game world.
zh_CN: 游戏世界中的一个位置。

keys: The world position under a screen pixel - click-to-place, a gamepad cursor, a HUD marker dragged onto the map. The exact opposite of World Point To Screen, so the two round-trip.
zh_CN: 某个屏幕像素下方的世界位置 - 点击放置、手柄光标、拖到地图上的 HUD 标记。它与“世界坐标转屏幕坐标”正好相反，两者可以来回转换。
屏幕点 [b]{screen_point}[/b] 的世界位置

keys: A position in screen pixels, with 0,0 at the top-left of the view.
zh_CN: 以像素表示的屏幕位置，0,0 在视图左上角。

keys: Where a 3D world point lands on screen - nameplates over 3D characters, damage numbers, objective pins drawn on a CanvasLayer. Reads as 0,0 while there is no active 3D camera, so it never faults during a scene change. Check Is Behind Camera (3D) first: a point behind you still projects to a number.
zh_CN: 一个 3D 世界坐标点落在屏幕上的位置 - 3D 角色头顶的名牌、伤害数字、画在 CanvasLayer 上的目标图钉。没有活动的 3D 摄像机时读作 0,0，所以切换场景时它绝不会出错。请先检查“在摄像机后方（3D）”：位于你身后的点同样会投影出一个数字。

keys: True while a world point is inside the visible view - the honest gate for spawning, culling, showing an off-screen arrow, or holding a tutorial callout until its subject is actually visible.
zh_CN: 当一个世界坐标点位于可见视图内时为真 - 生成、剔除、显示屏幕外箭头，或者把教程提示留到它的主体真正可见时才出现，这些场合最诚实的判断。

keys: Pixels of slack outside the view that still count as on screen. Negative pulls the test inward.
zh_CN: 视图之外仍然算作在屏幕上的像素余量。负值会把测试范围向内收。

keys: True when a 3D point sits behind the camera plane, where its projected screen position is a mirrored lie. The guard every 3D waypoint marker needs before it draws. With no camera in the scene it reads true, so nothing is drawn into a view that does not exist.
zh_CN: 当一个 3D 点位于摄像机平面后方时为真，此时它投影出的屏幕位置是一个镜像的谎言。每个 3D 路点标记在绘制前都需要的守卫。场景里没有摄像机时它读作真，于是不会往一个并不存在的视图里画东西。

keys: A screen position that follows a target while it is visible and sticks to the edge of the view once it is not - the off-screen objective arrow, the radar blip, the "your teammate is over there" chevron. Pair it with Marker Angle Toward for the rotation.
zh_CN: 目标可见时跟随它、不可见时贴在视图边缘的一个屏幕位置 - 屏幕外的目标箭头、雷达光点、“你的队友在那边”的指示符。搭配“标记指向角度”来得到旋转。

keys: How far in from the edge the marker is parked.
zh_CN: 标记停在离边缘多远的地方。

keys: The rotation in degrees an on-screen arrow needs so it points from the middle of the view at a world thing - the other half of the off-screen marker, and it stays right while the camera zooms or rotates.
zh_CN: 屏幕上的箭头需要多少度的旋转，才能从视图中心指向世界中的某个东西 - 屏幕外标记的另一半，而且摄像机缩放或旋转时它依然正确。

keys: The rectangle of the world the camera can currently see, in world coordinates - spawn just outside it, cull outside it, clamp a node inside it, or size a minimap to it. Follows the camera's zoom and position with nothing to keep in sync.
zh_CN: 摄像机当前能看到的那块世界矩形，以世界坐标表示 - 在它外面一点生成、在它外面剔除、把节点限制在里面，或者按它来设定小地图的大小。它跟随摄像机的缩放和位置，无需你同步任何东西。

keys: The Asteroids rule in 3D: leave the right of the view and come back on the left, off the top and back at the bottom, at the same distance from the camera. The missing twin of the 2D Wrap Inside The Screen, for a wrap-around arena or an endless shoal. Does nothing while there is no 3D camera.
zh_CN: 3D 版的《爆破彗星》规则：从视图右边离开就从左边回来，从上面出去就从下面回来，与摄像机的距离保持不变。2D “在屏幕内循环”缺失的那个孪生兄弟，适合环绕式竞技场或无尽鱼群。没有 3D 摄像机时它什么也不做。

keys: An evenly spread random point inside a circle - the sqrt weighting is done for you, so scatter does not bunch up in the middle the way the obvious version does.
zh_CN: 圆内均匀分布的随机点 - 平方根加权已经替你做好，所以散布不会像想当然的写法那样在中间堆成一团。
距 [b]{center}[/b] 不超过 [b]{radius}[/b] 的随机点

keys: A random point exactly ON the rim of a circle, never inside it - a spawn ring around the player, orbiting decor, a radial menu slot, the starting point of a homing shot.
zh_CN: 恰好落在圆周上、绝不落在圆内的随机点 - 玩家周围的生成环、环绕的装饰、径向菜单的槽位、追踪弹的起点。

keys: random point on a circle of [b]{radius}[/b] around [b]{center}[/b]
zh_CN: 以 [b]{center}[/b] 为中心、半径 [b]{radius}[/b] 的圆周上的随机点

keys: A random point in the doughnut between two radii - the off-screen spawner that never drops an enemy in the player's lap, and never so far away it never arrives. Evenly spread across the whole band, not crowded against the inner edge.
zh_CN: 两个半径之间那个甜甜圈里的随机点 - 既不会把敌人扔到玩家脸上、又不会远到永远走不过来的屏幕外生成器。在整条环带上均匀分布，不会挤在内缘。
距 [b]{center}[/b] 在 [b]{inner_radius}[/b] 与 [b]{outer_radius}[/b] 之间的随机点
生成位置不会比这更近。
生成位置不会比这更远。

keys: A random point inside an axis-aligned rectangle - loot scatter across a room, prop placement, confetti over a banner, a patrol target inside a zone. Feed it Visible World Rect's position and size to scatter across whatever the camera can see.
zh_CN: 轴对齐矩形内的随机点 - 房间里散落的战利品、道具摆放、横幅上方的彩纸、区域内的巡逻目标。把“可见世界矩形”的位置和大小喂给它，就能在摄像机能看到的范围内散布。

keys: random point in the rect at [b]{top_left}[/b] sized [b]{size}[/b]
zh_CN: 在 [b]{top_left}[/b] 处、大小为 [b]{size}[/b] 的矩形内的随机点
以像素为单位的宽和高。

keys: A random point inside a wedge - shotgun spread, cone attacks, directional scatter, a spray of sparks away from a wall. Facing and spread are in degrees, so the row reads the way you think about it.
zh_CN: 一个楔形里的随机点 - 霰弹散布、锥形攻击、定向散射、贴着墙飞溅的火花。朝向和张角都用度，所以这一行读起来和你脑子里想的一样。

keys: random point in a [b]{spread_degrees}[/b] cone facing [b]{facing_degrees}[/b] from [b]{center}[/b]
zh_CN: 从 [b]{center}[/b] 出发、朝向 [b]{facing_degrees}[/b]、张角 [b]{spread_degrees}[/b] 的扇形内的随机点

keys: Direction the wedge points, in degrees.
zh_CN: 楔形指向的方向，以度为单位。

keys: Total width of the cone in degrees, half either side of facing.
zh_CN: 扇形的总宽度（度），朝向两侧各占一半。

keys: Random scatter around a node that is already in the scene - blood splats around a hit, footprints around a stomp, sparkles around a pickup, a wander target around home. Pick the node instead of typing its position, and the scatter follows it as it moves.
zh_CN: 围绕场景中已有节点的随机散布 - 命中处的血迹、踩踏后的脚印、拾取物周围的闪光、以家为中心的游荡目标。选节点而不是手打位置，散布就会随它一起移动。
[i]{node}[/i] 周围 [b]{min_radius}[/b] 到 [b]{max_radius}[/b] 的随机点

keys: Node the point is scattered around.
A random unit direction in 2D - multiply it by a speed for a random shove, by a distance for a random offset. Always exactly one unit long, so the strength stays where you set it.
zh_CN: 2D 中的一个随机单位方向 - 乘以速度得到随机推力，乘以距离得到随机偏移。长度永远正好是一个单位，所以强度还是你设定的那个。

keys: A random unit direction in 3D, evenly spread over the whole sphere. The naive three-random-numbers version crowds the corners of a cube; this one does not, so debris and shrapnel fly out honestly.
zh_CN: 3D 中的随机单位方向，在整个球面上均匀分布。朴素的“三个随机数”写法会挤在立方体的角上；这个不会，所以碎片和弹片飞得诚实。

keys: An evenly spread random point inside a 3D sphere - spawn clouds, debris fields, flocking targets. The cube-root weighting keeps the middle from filling up first.
zh_CN: 3D 球体内均匀分布的随机点 - 生成云团、碎片场、集群目标。立方根加权让中间不会先被填满。
距 [b]{center}[/b] 不超过 [b]{radius}[/b] 的随机点（3D）

keys: A random point inside an axis-aligned 3D box - scatter trees over a chunk, spawn enemies in a room volume, place ambient audio emitters. Size is the FULL box, measured around the centre.
zh_CN: 轴对齐 3D 盒体内的随机点 - 在一个区块里撒树、在房间体积里生成敌人、放置环境音源。大小是整个盒体的尺寸，以中心为基准。

keys: random point in a [b]{size}[/b] box at [b]{center}[/b]
zh_CN: 在 [b]{center}[/b] 处、大小为 [b]{size}[/b] 的盒体内的随机点

keys: A random WORLD position on the border of what the camera can see - the wave spawner that comes in from a random side, ambient wildlife entering the frame, a meteor starting its run. Grow it with Visible World Rect if you want them to appear from just outside.
zh_CN: 摄像机可见范围边界上的一个随机世界位置 - 从随机一侧涌来的波次生成器、进入画面的环境生物、开始俯冲的陨石。想让它们从刚好在画面外出现，就用“可见世界矩形”把范围放大一点。

keys: random point on the screen edge

Nudges a value by a random amount up to the size you give - pitch variation on a sound, a pixel or two of scatter on a decal, a shade of variation on a tint. Works on numbers, vectors and colors as long as the amount is the same kind of value.
zh_CN: 把一个值随机地推动不超过你给定的幅度 - 音效的音高变化、贴花上一两个像素的偏移、染色上的一点深浅差别。只要幅度是同一种值，数字、向量和颜色都能用。

keys: The number, vector or color being nudged.
zh_CN: 被推动的数字、向量或颜色。

keys: The most it can move, as the SAME kind of value - a number for a number, a Vector2 for a position, a Color for a tint.
zh_CN: 它最多能移动多少，必须是同一种值 - 数字对数字，位置用 Vector2，染色用 Color。

keys: The velocity a moving thing has AFTER hitting a surface - feed it the normal any hit trigger or raycast hands you. Ricochets, pinball, breakout, deflect shields.
zh_CN: 一个运动中的物体撞到表面之后的速度 - 把任何命中触发器或射线检测给你的法线喂进去。跳弹、弹球、打砖块、偏转护盾。

keys: How the thing was moving when it hit.
The normal any hit trigger or raycast hands you.
zh_CN: 任何命中触发器或射线检测给你的那个法线。

keys: 1 keeps all the speed, 0.6 is a rubber ball, 0 is a dead stop.
zh_CN: 1 保留全部速度，0.6 像橡皮球，0 是完全停住。

keys: The velocity left over once the part pushing INTO a surface is removed - a wall slide that keeps you moving along the wall instead of sticking to it, slope movement, a dash that grazes a corner rather than stopping dead.
zh_CN: 去掉“压进表面”的那部分之后剩下的速度 - 让你贴着墙继续移动而不是黏在墙上的贴墙滑行、斜坡移动、擦过拐角而不是当场停死的冲刺。

keys: How the thing was moving when it met the surface.
zh_CN: 碰到表面时它的运动方式。

keys: The heading in degrees a thing travels on after bouncing off a surface - the answer to feed straight back into Set Angle Of Motion when a bullet should ricochet instead of dying.
zh_CN: 一个物体从表面弹开之后前进的朝向（度）- 当子弹应该跳弹而不是消失时，直接喂回“设置运动角度”的那个答案。

keys: The heading it was travelling on, in degrees.
zh_CN: 它原本前进的朝向，以度为单位。

keys: A position just clear of a surface instead of exactly on it - park a ricocheting bullet, a decal or a spawned effect here. Landing exactly on a surface is how a thing ends up stuck inside it on the next frame, because a ray that starts inside a shape does not report it.
zh_CN: 一个刚好脱离表面、而不是正好贴在表面上的位置 - 把跳弹的子弹、贴花或生成的特效停在这里。正好落在表面上，正是一个物体下一帧陷进去的原因，因为从形状内部出发的射线不会报告它。

keys: Pixels of daylight to leave between the thing and the surface.
zh_CN: 在物体和表面之间留出的像素空隙。

keys: Turns this node to point the way it is travelling, and leaves it alone while it is standing still so a stopped thing never snaps back to facing right. Arrows, fish, cars, thrown knives, a camera that leads the motion.
zh_CN: 让这个节点转向它前进的方向，静止时则不去动它，所以停下来的东西绝不会突然弹回朝右。箭矢、鱼、汽车、飞刀，以及领着运动走的摄像机。

keys: How this node is moving - Get Velocity on a body, or the direction you are driving it with.
zh_CN: 这个节点的运动方式 - 物体上的“获取速度”，或者你驱动它的那个方向。

keys: Turns a 3D node to face a point WITHOUT the crash the plain Look At has: when the target is directly overhead or underfoot, the usual up vector points the same way as the look direction and Godot cannot build a rotation from that. This one swaps the up vector at the last moment, and does nothing at all when the target is where the node already is.
zh_CN: 让一个 3D 节点朝向某个点，而且不会有普通“看向”那样的崩溃：当目标正好在头顶或脚下时，通常的上方向向量与视线方向重合，Godot 无法据此构造旋转。这个会在最后关头换掉上方向向量，而当目标就在节点自己所在处时，它什么也不做。

keys: Turns a 3D node to face a point but only around the up axis, so a character looks at the player without tipping over to stare at their feet. The rotation every humanoid, turret base and standing NPC actually wants.
zh_CN: 让一个 3D 节点朝向某个点，但只绕上轴旋转，于是角色看向玩家时不会歪倒去盯着人家的脚。每个人形、炮塔底座和站立 NPC 真正想要的那种旋转。

keys: Where to aim so a shot MEETS a moving target instead of trailing it - the interception point every turret and archer needs. When the target is faster than the shot no lead exists, and it falls back to the target's current spot rather than pointing somewhere absurd.
zh_CN: 该往哪里打，才能让一发射击迎上移动的目标而不是追在它后面 - 每个炮塔和弓箭手都需要的拦截点。当目标比射击还快时不存在提前量，它会退回目标当前的位置，而不是指向某个荒唐的方向。
瞄准位于 [b]{target_position}[/b]、速度为 [b]{target_velocity}[/b] 的目标

keys: Where the target is right now.
How the target is moving, in pixels per second.
zh_CN: 目标的运动速度，以像素每秒计。

keys: How fast your shot travels, in pixels per second.
zh_CN: 你的射击飞得多快，以像素每秒计。

keys: The angle in degrees to fire something so it ARCS onto a target - grenades, mortars, catapults, a coin tossed into a counter. Picks the flatter of the two possible arcs, and reads as 45 degrees when the shot cannot reach at all, so a row never produces a number that is not a number.
zh_CN: 要让东西以弧线落到目标上，应该以多少度发射 - 手雷、迫击炮、投石机、抛进柜台的硬币。它会在两条可能的弧线里选更平的那条，而当射程根本够不着时读作 45 度，所以这一行绝不会产出一个“不是数字”的数字。

keys: launch angle to reach [b]{distance}[/b] away, [b]{height}[/b] up
zh_CN: 发射角：到达 [b]{distance}[/b] 远、[b]{height}[/b] 高处

keys: How far away the target is, along the ground.
How much higher the target is than the launcher; negative is downhill.
zh_CN: 目标比发射点高多少；负数表示往下打。

keys: How fast the thing leaves the launcher.
zh_CN: 物体离开发射点时有多快。

keys: Pull downward, in the same units as the speed.
zh_CN: 向下的拉力，单位与速度相同。

keys: How many seconds something moving at a steady speed needs to cover a distance - time a warning before the missile lands, size a tween to match a walk, decide whether the interceptor can get there first.
zh_CN: 以匀速运动的东西走完一段距离需要多少秒 - 在导弹落地前预留警告时间、让补间时长与走路匹配、判断拦截者能不能先到。
[b]{speed}[/b] 从 [b]{from_position}[/b] 到 [b]{to_position}[/b] 所需的时间

keys: Which grid cell a world position falls in - no TileMapLayer needed, so build grids, inventory slots and chunk keys all speak the same language. Negative positions land in negative cells, which is what a grid that extends left and up actually wants.
zh_CN: 一个世界位置落在哪个网格格子里 - 不需要 TileMapLayer，于是网格、物品栏格位和区块键都说同一种语言。负的位置落在负的格子里，这正是一个向左、向上延伸的网格真正想要的。

keys: Pixels across one cell. Type Tiles(1) to read your project's own tile size instead.
zh_CN: 一个格子有多少像素宽。输入 Tiles(1) 可以改用你项目自己的图块大小。

keys: The world position at the middle of a grid cell - where the placement ghost sits, where the tower is built, where the piece lands. The exact partner of Cell Of Point, so the pair round-trips.
zh_CN: 一个网格格子正中间的世界位置 - 放置幽灵预览待的地方、塔建起来的地方、棋子落下的地方。它是“点所在的格子”的精确搭档，两者可以来回转换。

keys: center of cell [b]{cell}[/b] on a [b]{cell_size}[/b] grid
zh_CN: 格子 [b]{cell}[/b] 在 [b]{cell_size}[/b] 网格上的中心
一个格子有多少像素宽。

keys: The nearest grid intersection to a loose position - a dragged card falling into its slot, a level editor brush, a UI element clicking onto a column. Rounds to the nearest, so a thing dropped just past halfway moves forward rather than back.
zh_CN: 离一个松散位置最近的网格交点 - 落进槽位的拖拽卡牌、关卡编辑器的笔刷、咔哒对齐到某一列的 UI 元素。它取最近的一个，所以刚过半程的东西会往前走而不是退回去。

keys: The nearest point on a 3D grid - voxel placement, modular level pieces clicking together, a build cursor that lines up with the floor tiles.
zh_CN: 3D 网格上最近的点 - 体素放置、拼接式关卡组件的咔哒对齐、与地板图块对齐的建造光标。

keys: How far apart two grid cells are, with the same geometry dropdown the rest of the plugin uses: straight line, horizontal or vertical only, grid steps (Manhattan) or king moves (Chebyshev). One expression that fits a roguelike, a strategy game and a puzzle board alike.
zh_CN: 两个网格格子相距多远，用的是插件其他地方一样的那个几何下拉框：直线、只算水平或垂直、网格步数（曼哈顿）或王步（切比雪夫）。一个表达式同时适合 roguelike、策略游戏和益智棋盘。

keys: distance from cell [b]{from_cell}[/b] to [b]{to_cell}[/b], measured as [b]{metric}[/b]
zh_CN: 从格子 [b]{from_cell}[/b] 到 [b]{to_cell}[/b] 的距离，按 [b]{metric}[/b] 计算

keys: How the distance is counted - a roguelike wants Grid steps, a chess board wants King moves.
zh_CN: 距离怎么算 - roguelike 要网格步数，国际象棋盘要王步。

keys: The cells touching a cell, as a list - flood fill, path search, "is anything next to me", spreading fire, match-three clearing. Choose four sides, eight including diagonals, or the six neighbours of an axial hex board.
zh_CN: 与一个格子相邻的那些格子，以列表返回 - 洪水填充、路径搜索、“我旁边有东西吗”、火势蔓延、三消消除。可以选四邻、含对角的八邻，或者轴向六边形棋盘的六个邻居。

keys: The cell whose neighbours you want.
zh_CN: 你想取其邻居的那个格子。

keys: How cells touch on this board.
zh_CN: 在这个棋盘上格子如何相邻。

keys: Every cell a straight line passes through, in order from one cell to the other - a laser beam's path, tile-based line of sight, a corridor carved between two rooms, a ruler for a ranged attack. Both ends are included.
zh_CN: 一条直线经过的每个格子，从一端到另一端依次排列 - 激光束的路径、基于图块的视线、两个房间之间凿出的走廊、远程攻击的量尺。两端都包含在内。

keys: cells in the line from [b]{from_cell}[/b] to [b]{to_cell}[/b]
zh_CN: 从 [b]{from_cell}[/b] 到 [b]{to_cell}[/b] 直线上的格子

keys: Every cell within a step radius of a centre cell, as a list - a blast footprint, a range preview, a fog reveal, the tiles a tower covers. Choose the diamond (counting grid steps) or the square (counting king moves).
zh_CN: 距离中心格子在若干步以内的每个格子，以列表返回 - 爆炸范围、射程预览、迷雾揭示、一座塔覆盖的图块。可以选菱形（按网格步数算）或方形（按王步算）。

keys: How many steps out from the middle.

Every cell in a rectangular block, row by row - stamping a room, laying out an inventory grid, placing a multi-cell building, clearing a region of fog. An empty or negative size walks nothing rather than looping backwards.
zh_CN: 一个矩形区块内的每个格子，一行一行排列 - 盖出一个房间、排布物品栏网格、放置占多格的建筑、清除一片迷雾。大小为空或为负时它一个也不走，而不是倒着循环。

keys: How many cells across and down.
zh_CN: 横向和纵向各有多少格。

keys: True while a cell is on the board - the guard before every placement, every move and every array lookup keyed by cell. Counting starts at 0,0 in the top-left, so a 20 by 12 board's last cell is 19,11.
zh_CN: 当一个格子在棋盘上时为真 - 每次放置、每次移动、每次按格子查数组之前该有的守卫。计数从左上角的 0,0 开始，所以 20 乘 12 的棋盘最后一格是 19,11。
格子 [b]{cell}[/b] 在 [b]{size}[/b] 的棋盘内

keys: How many cells the board is across and down.
zh_CN: 棋盘横向和纵向各有多少格。
遍历半径内的每个格子

keys: Runs this event's actions once per cell within a step radius of a centre cell - range previews, blast footprints, fog reveal, area-of-effect highlights. Read the current one as `cell`.
zh_CN: 对距离中心格子若干步以内的每个格子各运行一次本事件的动作 - 射程预览、爆炸范围、迷雾揭示、范围效果高亮。用 `cell` 读取当前这一个。
遍历 [b]{center}[/b] 周围 [b]{radius}[/b] 以内的每个格子

keys: How strong an effect is at a distance, from 1 at the centre to 0 at the edge - the one number that makes an explosion, a sound, a magnet or a screen shake care how close it was. Anything past the radius reads as 0, so it is safe to multiply straight into damage. For a hand-drawn profile, feed this number into Sample Curve.
zh_CN: 一个效果在某个距离上的强度，从中心的 1 递减到边缘的 0 - 让爆炸、声音、磁力或屏幕震动懂得“离得多近”的那一个数字。超出半径的一律读作 0，所以直接乘进伤害里也很安全。想要手绘的曲线，就把这个数字喂给“采样曲线”。
从 [b]{center}[/b] 到 [b]{point}[/b] 在 [b]{radius}[/b] 内的衰减

keys: How quickly the strength drops off with distance.
zh_CN: 强度随距离下降得多快。

keys: Falloff between THIS node and another one, without spelling out either position - guard suspicion that builds faster the closer you are, a magnet that pulls harder up close, a sound that ducks as you approach. Reads 0 once the other node is out of range.
zh_CN: 这个节点与另一个节点之间的衰减，无需写出任何一方的位置 - 越靠近涨得越快的守卫警觉度、离近了拉得更狠的磁铁、你一走近就压低的声音。对方节点超出范围时读作 0。
在 [b]{radius}[/b] 内朝向 [i]{node}[/i] 的强度

keys: The node the strength is measured against.
zh_CN: 强度所针对的那个节点。

keys: Throws this physics body away from a blast, weaker the further it was - barrels, crates, ragdolls and debris flung by an explosion. One row on the body; the blast only has to say where it happened.
zh_CN: 把这个物理体从爆炸处推开，越远越弱 - 被爆炸掀飞的桶、板条箱、布娃娃和碎片。物体上只要一行；爆炸只需要说清它发生在哪里。
从 [b]{center}[/b] 施加强度 [b]{strength}[/b] 的径向冲量

keys: The push at the very centre, in impulse units.
zh_CN: 正中心处的推力，以冲量单位计。

keys: Past this the push is nothing.
zh_CN: 超出这个距离，推力为零。

keys: Shoves every member of a group away from a point, hardest at the centre and not at all past the radius - the mirror of Pull Group Toward. A shockwave clearing a crowd, a repulsor field, a dash that parts the enemies it passes through.
zh_CN: 把一个分组的每个成员从某个点推开，中心最猛、超出半径则完全不推 - “把分组拉向”的镜像。清场的冲击波、斥力场、把途中敌人分开的冲刺。
把分组 [b]{group}[/b] 从 [b]{center}[/b] 推开，范围 [b]{radius}[/b]
成员会被推开的那个分组。

keys: Only members inside this are shoved.
zh_CN: 只有在这个范围内的成员会被推开。

keys: Pixels the closest member is moved.
zh_CN: 最近的成员被移动多少像素。

keys: True while a point sits inside a facing wedge - guard vision, spotlight checks, melee arcs, directional blasts. The cheap test to put in front of an expensive raycast: if it is not in the cone, there is nothing to trace.
zh_CN: 当一个点位于朝向楔形内时为真 - 守卫视野、聚光灯判定、近战弧、定向爆破。放在昂贵的射线检测前面的那道廉价判定：不在扇形里，就没什么可追踪的。

keys: [b]{point}[/b] is within a [b]{fov_degrees}[/b] cone of [b]{origin}[/b] facing [b]{facing_degrees}[/b]
zh_CN: [b]{point}[/b] 位于 [b]{origin}[/b] 朝向 [b]{facing_degrees}[/b]、张角 [b]{fov_degrees}[/b] 的扇形内

keys: Tip of the wedge - the guard, the spotlight, the blast.
zh_CN: 楔形的顶点 - 守卫、聚光灯、爆炸点。

keys: Which way the wedge points, in degrees.
zh_CN: 楔形指向哪一边，以度为单位。

keys: Total width of the wedge in degrees.
zh_CN: 楔形的总宽度，以度为单位。

keys: How far the wedge extends, in pixels.
zh_CN: 楔形延伸多远，以像素计。

keys: Pauses this event until a check comes true, or until the give-up time passes. Read which happened on the next row with Wait Succeeded / Wait Timed Out, naming this wait. It polls once a frame, so prefer Wait For Signal when a real signal exists for what you are waiting on.
zh_CN: 暂停这个事件，直到某个判断成立，或者放弃时间到了。在下一行用“等待成功 / 等待超时”并写上这次等待的名字来读取结果。它每帧轮询一次，所以当真的存在对应信号时，优先用“等待信号”。
等待 [b]{wait_name}[/b] 直到 [b]{check}[/b]，[b]{seconds}[/b] 秒后放弃

keys: A name for this wait, so Wait Succeeded / Wait Timed Out can say which one they mean.
zh_CN: 给这次等待起个名字，好让“等待成功 / 等待超时”说清楚它们指的是哪一次。

keys: The check to wait for, tested once a frame.
zh_CN: 要等待的判断，每帧检测一次。

keys: Seconds before giving up. 0 waits forever.
zh_CN: 多少秒后放弃。0 表示一直等下去。
